articleTitle: Evaluation of Superior Accuracy of Faster RCNN over Conventional Forensic Techniques in Image Tampering Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The demand for digital image fraud detection is rapidly increasing in society due to the importance of having certified images. The analysis encompasses the identification of picture copy move, image splicing, image retouching, and image resampling forgeries. A tampering detection system is crucial for detecting image tapering and verifying the validity of photos. In this work, an effective algorithm called as Faster Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network (F-RCNN) is proposed to enhance the accuracy of the detection of an image tampering. Despite the fact that several detection technologies are now available, their accuracy and reliability fall well short of expectations. Current methods rely on a single network topology with many neurons and deep layers, which is insufficient for detecting forgeries. The proposed algorithm is working well with the detection system of image tampering with the integration of Naive Byes classifier along with the proposed algorithm. The faster RCNN is consists of deep layers of CNN that is significance to extract features and to detect the tampered image. The proposed algorithm ensures its efficient detection of an image tampering by providing the accuracy level of $\mathbf{92 \%}$ with the various levels of epochs.

articleTitle: Air Pollution Monitoring System using Machine Learning techniques for Smart cities
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Monitoring the environment is a complex task that is crucial for all living beings. Urban and industrial areas are particularly vulnerable to pollution, which can lead to various health issues. This system utilizes data analysis and machine learning to monitor and classify regions where gas emissions exceed permissible levels. Unlike existing systems, which can only predict air quality in small areas with limited efficiency, the proposed system can accurately predict air quality across larger regions. By factoring in the temperature of a specific location—since air quality is heavily influenced by global warming—the system can predict air grade. The DBSCAN algorithm proves to be particularly effective in identifying highly polluted areas, outperforming other algorithms in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Air Quality Operational Centres (AQOCs) are crucial in identifying regions with severe pollution. These centres analyse data gathered by various units to make final assessments. The predicting air pollution relied on complex physiochemical processes and dispersion models, which were both time-consuming and required large datasets, making them less efficient for practical use.

articleTitle: Real Time Prediction of Diabetes by using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The prognosis of diabetes, a chronic metabolic disorder, is crucial for early intervention and management. This study explores the integration of various machine learning approaches to enhance the accuracy and reliability of diabetes prognosis. The integration process encompasses rigorous cross-validation and hyper parameter tuning to optimize model efficacy. The findings demonstrate that leveraging multiple machine learning models not only increases prognostic accuracy but also provides a robust framework for handling diverse patient data. This integrated approach shows promise in supporting healthcare professionals with precise predictions, ultimately leading to better patient management and outcomes. The study also addresses the challenges of model complexity, computational cost, and interpretability, proposing solutions to mitigate these issues. The integration is done by stacking, an advanced ensembling method. The model developed is the results of accurately stacking the basic model. The divided data is examined using ML classifiers, and the classifier’s accuracy is calculated. Moreover, particular measures such as precision, recall, and F1 score are compared to each model’s prediction accuracy to choose the optimal model. The proposed method gives a high prediction accuracy of about 99 percentage.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Forecasting Mechanism for Cardiovascular Diseases: A Hybrid Approach using MLP and K-NN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) results in malfunctioning of the heart and also the related blood vessels and regularly primes to death or corporal paralysis. Initial and automated discovery of CVD is crucial for saving many of the common humanoid lives. While several Investigations have been carried out to achieve this goal, and there is still room for development in terms of performance and reliability. This new work provides one more step in this area, since it utilizes two reliable ML algorithms, “multi-layer perceptron (MLP)” and “K-nearest neighbour (K-NN)“to detect CVD using publicly available data from the University of Engineering California Irvine source. The models’ concerts are enhanced optimally and by eradicating the possible outliers and common existing attributes with values that are treated as null. They performed general Experimental and effective findings show that the MLP model outperforms the KNN model in terms of reporting accuracy ($82.47 \%$) and area below the curve ($86.41 \%$). As a result, the proposed MLP model is recommended for automated CVD identification. Furthermore, this approach may be used to identify new illnesses, and the suggested model’s routine can be tested against other standard datasets.

articleTitle: Revealing Cyber Risks: Malicious URL Detection with Diverse Machine Learning Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of cyber threats, particularly those propagated through malicious URLs, underscores the need for robust security measures. This research proposes a machine learning-based approach to effectively identify and neutralize malicious URLs. The proposed system integrates Random Forest and XGBoost algorithms to analyze URL features such as length, special characters, and domain information. These powerful algorithms are capable of handling large datasets and complex feature interactions, enabling accurate classification of URLs as benign or malicious. The system’s performance is evaluated using various metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in detecting malicious URLs with high accuracy and precision. By integrating this system into cybersecurity infrastructure, organizations can significantly enhance their security posture, protect sensitive data, and mitigate the risks associated with malicious URLs.

articleTitle: Improving Wheat Yield Protection with Deep Feature Fusion for Estimating Yellow Rust Severity Using CNN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Wheat is one significant staple crop that is under severe threat from diseases like yellow rust, which might cause it to lose a significant portion of its yield. Early detection and severity evaluation of the illness are critical to the effective use of insecticides and disease management. This article presents a method for estimating the severity of yellow rust in wheat leaves by combining deep characteristics from two convolutional neural network (CNN) models. To create deep features from photos, VGG16 and MobileNetV2 are first trained. After using generic fusion rules to fuse these characteristics, support vector machines (SVM) are employed for classification. The Yellow-Rust-19 dataset is used in experiments to show that combining deep features increases accuracy by about 0.4% when compared to using separate CNN models. The findings highlight how deep feature fusion may improve disease severity estimation, which will help with crop protection and disease management.

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: A Deep Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a prevalent, crippling lung ailment that often progresses undetected until its advanced stages, leading to significant morbidity and mortality. Early prediction and interference are crucial to improving patient outcomes. Here, a novel approach for the early prediction of COPD using deep transfer learning is proposed. Three cutting edge models from deep transfer learning, namely Inception, ResNet, and VGGNet, are trained to extract and classify features from audio recordings of breathing sounds. These models are fine-tuned on a dataset consisting of sounds from both healthy individuals and those with COPD, along with six other lung disorders. The extracted features are used to predict the presence of COPD, enabling early detection and intervention. The outcome of the proposed methodology demonstrates the efficiency of the model’s capability to predict COPD, with the deep transfer learning models achieving high precision in distinguishing COPD patients from non-COPD individuals. This approach shows the potential for cost-effective and early prediction of COPD, facilitating timely interventions and improved management of the disease.

articleTitle: Detection System of Whaling Attack using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Cyber security attacks are becoming among the most common issue that deals with governments, general internet and organizations. “Whaling” is a kind of targeted phishing that aims specifically at senior executives by masquerading as legitimate email. A kind of social engineering-based digital fraud known as “whaling” involves tricking victims into doing a secondary action, such as starting a wire transfer of money. As a defence against this danger, this study suggested a deep learning-based method for detecting whaling attacks. The dataset is initially partitioned for training the detection model and evaluating its results using the test data in order to capture the inherent qualities of the email text. In order to train and evaluate the whaling email detection accuracy using the collected features, a neural network technique was selected. The additional features are categorized into three groups such as whaling email group, group of approved emails and junk emails. Experimental analysis is analysed by comparing existing methods with the proposed methods. After making evaluation between them, the proposed method achieved the most accurate and efficient results.

articleTitle: Colourization of Black and White Images using Convolutional Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Image colourization, the process of adding colour to grayscale images, remains a significant challenge in computer vision with diverse applications in digital media. This paper presents the development and evaluation of a convolutional autoencoder model designed for automatic image colourization. The methodology involves converting grayscale images into the LAB colour space, where the ‘L’ channel is used as input to predict the ‘A’ and ‘B’ channels. The model architecture integrates convolutional layers for feature extraction and upsampling layers for image reconstruction. The Adam optimizer is employed to minimize the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) during training. Utilizing a landscape image dataset and incorporating data augmentation techniques, the model achieved an accuracy of 85.34%, demonstrating effective colour preservation and detail enhancement. This approach automates the colourization process with high efficiency and provides valuable insights for practical applications in digital media.

articleTitle: Ensemble Learning Approaches for Predicting Flood Damage: A Comprehensive Analysis and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research aims to address the urgent need for a highly accurate predictive model that can estimate postflood damages using historical data of flood events in the United States since January 1950. Floods, as one of the most destructive natural disasters, inflict significant harm on infrastructure, homes, and human lives. Anticipating flood damage is essential for effective disaster management and risk mitigation. Employing the capabilities of ensemble learning techniques such as Random Forest and XGBoost, the model aims to provide near-precise predictions of the potential damage resulting from a flooding event. Simultaneously, the socio-economic dimension of the model integrates demographic data, infrastructure details, and historical economic indicators to comprehend the susceptibility of communities to flood damage.

articleTitle: MediScan: Advanced Medical Imaging Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: MediScan is a web-based application designed for people to get first-hand opinions on their medical scans and stress the importance of seeking professional advice on the basis of the severity of the conditions identified. The application uses datasets that contain X Ray images of the bones (including un fractured and simple fractures) and MRI scan of the human brain that includes healthy brains and tumors like glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumors. The study compares different machine learning techniques such as Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naïve Bayes, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for identification of the best model for such an estimation. Random Forest achieves $\mathbf{8 5. 6 4 \%}$ accuracy was selected as the best fit. The model was then integrated into a Streamlit-based interface to generate real-time predictions and expedite deployment. It is equipped with features that enable interactive data analysis and visualization that even a layman can easily use. MediScan demonstrates the opportunities and prospects of machine learning in medical imaging, it is an effective tool for the initial medical examination that can potentially save the time of specialists and contribute to timely medical interventions. This study demonstrates the important role that machine learning applications play in improving the ability to diagnose and access health services.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Strategies for Accurate Segmentation and Categorization of Unveiling Genetic Disorders in Bioinformatics
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Women all across the world are affected by the potentially fatal condition known as breast cancer. According to clinical experts, early cancer detection helps to save lives. Several machine learning algorithms have been developed to classify cancers in order to diagnose breast cancer, and medical image processing has been found to be a beneficial area for increasing classification accuracy. One of the most crucial signs for detecting breast cancer early is micro classifications. Machine learning methods have been employed in numerous studies to address this problem. Various classification algorithms are used to find the presence of breast cancer whether it is Benign or Malignant. For earlier cancer detection and diagnosis, an image enhancement approach is being developed. A machine learning technique is employed in this work to attempt to categorize breast cancer. The purpose of the present research was to increase the accuracy of machine learning methods for disease diagnosis using ML techniques.

articleTitle: Human Gait Analysis with Hybrid Deep Learning Network CNN-SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In the world of digitization, Security concerns arise in private as well as public places like airports, metro stations, banks, and even at homes. This has led to diversity in the research area, and modern video surveillance systems can be considered one of them. One of its’ subsets can be put under Human Gait, where brilliant minds have already provided a breakthrough in the research industry. Human Gait involves the movement of limbs during locomotion it comprises of various ways in which a human being can walk. Now coming to human gait recognition, these systems can recognize the walking style of a person from a pretty long distance despite of any interaction with the machines as in biometrics. In this paper, the implementation follows Human Gait Recognition using Feature extraction through Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Classification through Support Vector Machine (SVM). The preferred framework involves Data pre-processing, Feature Extraction, and Classification. The CNN SVM was trained for 9041 images out of which some were kept for testing and some for-testing purposes. The model was trained for the first four steps of the human gait cycle including Initial Contact, Loading Response, Mid Stance, and Terminal stance. Recognition of these four walking steps along with their accuracy rate. The maximum output proved out to be for Mid Stance which is 98.78%. The future scope of this implementation is much more awaited and can help in recognizing a person by identifying the walking patterns of an individual. This study may find its way in all IoT devices which will help in recognizing and authenticating an individual.

articleTitle: Integrated Battery Management and Thermal Control System for Lithium-Ion Battery Pack in Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This innovative technology represents a forward-thinking approach to enhance the efficiency, safety, and overall performance of batteries, with a particular emphasis on Electric Vehicle (EV) applications. By combining EV technology with the Internet of Things (IoT), this paper explores state-of-the-art solutions for comprehensive battery management. The fusion of EV technology and IoT has introduced a new era of intelligent battery management. It addresses key challenges in EV and battery-powered systems by monitoring, controlling, and optimizing various aspects of battery operation. A central aspect of this paper involves the use of Peltier devices, also known as thermoelectric coolers (TECs), strategically positioned to regulate battery module temperatures. This temperature control system is crucial in maintaining the battery within its specified temperature range, which is essential for both performance and safety. The Peltier devices offer adaptable temperature control tailored to specific environmental conditions. They cool the battery during hot weather to prevent overheating, and they generate electrical power when the temperature drops below the set threshold. By leveraging IoT technology, real-time monitoring and remote control of battery conditions are made possible. This enables proactive maintenance, early detection of faults, and data-driven decision-making [1]. IoT connectivity ensures that batteries can be managed and optimized efficiently, ultimately resulting in prolonged battery life, improved safety, and increased overall efficiency. In essence, this technology signifies the convergence of EV technology, IoT, and advanced temperature control mechanisms using Peltier devices, ushering in a new era of battery management. It has the potential to transform the way batteries are utilized in EVs and other applications, unlocking higher performance levels, enhanced safety, and sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: A Scalable Recommendation based Approach for Predictive Restaurant Ratings and Personalized Content Filtering using Zomato Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In recent years, the exponential growth of online restaurant platforms has revolutionized the dining experience, enabling users to explore various culinary options. Consequently, restaurant rating prediction and personalized recommendation systems have become indispensable tools for users seeking dining suggestions and platform operators aiming to enhance user engagement and satisfaction. The proposed integrated framework for Zomato combines rating prediction with content filtering to optimize user experiences. By integrating machine learning models, the ratings are predicted based on features like location and cuisine type, while content filtering personalizes recommendations. Real-world Zomato data experiments validate our framework’s efficacy in enhancing user satisfaction and engagement, offering tailored suggestions aligned with individual preferences. This work has an accuracy of 0.89 and f1 score of ${0. 8 1}$. Experimental results show significant improvements in rating prediction accuracy and the effectiveness of personalized recommendations, highlighting the potential of our approach to enhance the overall user experience on Zomato.

articleTitle: Image based Bird Species Identification using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Recent advancements in computer vision and deep learning have significantly enhanced the potential for image-based bird species identification, garnering considerable interest in ornithology and ecological research. The proposed system investigates the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for the automated and precise identification of bird species from photographic images. A variety of bird picture datasets are gathered, and tagged with relevant species labels, and a CNN model for species classification is trained using this process. Utilizing its capacity to learn spatial hierarchies and hierarchical characteristics, CNN can capture complex patterns in the morphology of birds. Transfer learning techniques may enhance model performance, especially when dealing with limited labelled data. The study aims to address challenges such as fine-grained discrimination, data imbalance, and variability in environmental conditions. The relevance is in offering a dependable and expandable method for identifying bird species, supporting citizen science projects, biodiversity protection, and ecological monitoring. The suggested CNN-based technique is effective in reliably classifying various bird species from photos, as demonstrated by implementation results and model evaluations. This will facilitate the development of automated systems for identifying species names, characters, and other information. The implementation is carried out with several bird image datasets collected from “CUB-200-2011” and “Birdsnap” datasets. The Kaggle dataset was also used for this study, and output was gained using the Python tool.

articleTitle: LSTM - Recurrent Neural Network Model to Forecast the Risk Factors in Recurrent Cervical Carcinoma
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Cervical carcinoma is a healthcare issue globally, and despite advancements in prevention, diagnosis and treatment, recurrence remains as a challenge. Understanding the risk factors associated with cervical cancer recurrence is crucial for optimizing patient care and improving outcomes. Multiple factors contribute to the possibility of cervical carcinoma metastasis. The important prognostic factor is the stage of the disease at diagnosis, with advanced stages are associated with a higher likelihood of recurrence. Other clinical chronic attributes like size of a cyst, inclusion of lymph nodes and what’s the kind of histology is also influence recurrence risk. Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, particularly with HPV that poses a danger genotypes, danger element for the emergence of cervical cancer. HPV persistence following initial treatment is strongly associated with increased recurrence rates. The risk factors of recurrence cervical cancer is found by Long Short Term Memory which is advancement in recurrent neural network classifier. Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and Deep Neural Network (DNN) classifiers are compared with LSTM. In which LSTM Model attains the highest accuracy. In conclusion, cervical cancer recurrence is influenced by an intricate connection amongst standard of living, molecular and clinical variables. These risk factors is important for forecasting individuals at higher risk of recurrence and tailoring personalized treatment strategies.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Detection and Classification of Child Malnutrition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Malnutrition remains a pervasive global health issue, affecting millions of children worldwide and manifesting in various forms from undernutrition to overnutrition. This study addresses the critical need for early detection and intervention by developing a robust deep learning-based system for classifying children’s nutritional status. Utilizing a diverse dataset, the performance of a baseline Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and various transfer learning models including ResNet, MobileNet, VGG16, and VGG19 was evaluated. The baseline CNN model, featuring five convolutional layers trained over 60 epochs, achieved a training accuracy of approximately 98.53% and a validation accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9. 8 3 \%}$. Among the transfer learning models, MobileNet and VGG16 exhibited superior performance, closely matching the baseline CNN’s effectiveness, while VGG19 demonstrated strong learning capabilities with slightly lower validation accuracy. ResNet, despite improvements in training accuracy, struggled with validation accuracy and generalization. This system has been integrated into a web application for real-time image classification, providing a valuable tool for healthcare professionals in the early detection and management of malnutrition. The findings in this study highlight the potential of deep learning models to enhance public health outcomes and support the global effort to combat child malnutrition through timely and accurate assessments.

articleTitle: Image Caption Generation using CNN and Audio Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research focuses on developing a system that can generate descriptive captions for images and convert them into audio output. The system employs a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract visual features from images, which are then fed into a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) to generate textual descriptions. The generated captions are subsequently converted into audio using text-to-speech techniques. By training the model on a large dataset of image-caption pairs, the system learns to associate visual information with textual descriptions, enabling accurate and coherent caption generation. This research contributes to the advancement of image understanding and generation, with potential applications in various fields such as image search, accessibility, and content creation.

articleTitle: Handy Skin Diseases using Deep Learning to detect Skin Infections While on the Go
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Skin diseases can significantly impact a person’s quality of life. Accurate and timely diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment. This research explores the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to improve dermatological diagnosis. The study utilizes the ISIC 2017 dataset, a large collection of dermatoscopic images, to train and evaluate various CNN architectures, including VGG-16, AlexNet, DermNet, GoogleNet, and MobileNetV2. Preprocessing techniques are employed to enhance image quality and facilitate accurate classification. The proposed hybrid model, combining DermNet and MobileNet with Softmax and ReLU activation functions, achieves an impressive accuracy of $100 \%$ in classifying skin diseases. This result demonstrates the potential of deep learning techniques to revolutionize dermatological diagnosis, enabling early detection and appropriate treatment.

articleTitle: Prediction and Detection of Fruit Diseases using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study presents a novel approach for automated fruit quality assessment using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The proposed method involves preprocessing fruit images to enhance feature extraction, followed by training a CNN model to classify fruits as fresh or rotten. By accurately identifying fruit quality, this system can significantly improve the efficiency and reliability of quality control processes in the food industry.

articleTitle: Enhancing Agricultural Productivity through Integrated Hyperspectral Imaging and Geospatial Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study examines how HSI is integrated with geospatial image processing to enhance high precision and efficiency while working on environmental and geographical data in various disciplines. Data was collected and analyzed with the help of sensors mounted on satellites and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Modern image processing tools were applied to assess this data, including spectrum unmixing, anomaly detection, and other classifications. It shows increased data quality and efficiency of operations after implementing Lean. Applying the integrated approach in line with those in agricultural applications ensured much better detection rates of stress on crops. In particular, the integrated technique improved the detection rates by $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$, increasing it from $\mathbf{7 0 \%}$ when using Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) alone to $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$ in four months. In the field of urban planning, the control of pollution has been enhanced due to the ability to identify areas with high pollution rates. This enhancement has led to an improved efficiency of 25 percent in pollution detection compared to older methods. The study also researched and developed new algorithm approaches that increased the fusion of spectral and geographical data by improving the analysis. These developments prognosticated possibilities for better tracking and controlling within environmental science and agriculture and the prospective application of the specified fields for urban planning and catastrophe relief. Nonetheless, the outcomes expound on the revolutionary aspect of integrating HSI and GIS technology in that it infers a significant leap in the ability to address and manipulate environmental data.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning and Forecasting Techniques to Enhance Credit Risk Analysis and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research presents a novel data-driven framework to improve credit risk assessment and minimize loan defaults. The framework leverages a combination of machine learning techniques, including Random Forest and XGBoost, to analyze a comprehensive dataset from Axis Bank spanning 2007-2015. The study focuses on key factors such as loan amount, debt-to-income ratio, interest rate, and debt burden to predict the likelihood of default. By employing oversampling techniques to address data imbalance and integrating ensemble methods, the framework enhances prediction accuracy. The results demonstrate the superior performance of the XGBoost model in accurately classifying loans as default or non-default. This research contributes to the advancement of credit risk management by providing a powerful tool for financial institutions to make informed lending decisions and mitigate financial risks.

articleTitle: Preventing Health Records Risk Analysis with Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The security of electronic health records plays a crucial concern in the healthcare industry due to the sensitive nature of the information and its ethical aspects. Security analysis of health records involves evaluating, managing, and preserving the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of sensitive healthcare information. Explainable AI plays a significant part in the security analysis of health records by offering transparency, interpretability, and accountability in the decision-making process, thereby enhancing trust, compliance, and proactive risk management in handling sensitive healthcare information. The proper implementing of explainable AI in practice in healthcare organizations can significantly reduce the risks associated with handling sensitivee health records and ensure patient data remains secure and confidential.

articleTitle: The Grid-Connected Double Stage PV System with SVPWM Cascaded H- Bridge Multi Level Inverter and Current Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study presents a novel approach to grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) systems using a double-stage configuration. The proposed system uses an advanced current controller that incorporates a PWM technique of Modulation of Space Vector Pulse Width for a Cascaded H-Bridge Multi-Level Inverter. The double-stage architecture enables efficient power conversion and grid integration while ensuring stability and reliability. The Space vector PWM technique optimizes the inverter’s switching patterns, enhancing the system’s performance and reducing harmonic distortion. The current controller provides precise regulation, further improving the system’s dynamic response and grid compatibility. Simulation results show how successful the suggested system is in maximizing solar power utilization, ensuring grid stability, and minimizing harmonic distortion, making it a promising solution for modern grid-connected PV applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Skin Cancer Detection using CNN, ResNet, and Hybrid Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Skin cancer is a prevalent and potentially life-threatening condition, making early and accurate detection crucial for effective treatment. This work proposes a novel hybrid approach to skin cancer detection, integrating both deep learning and traditional ML techniques. Utilizing a dataset from Kaggle, the process began with initial classification using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and achieved an accuracy of 90%. Features were then extracted using Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG), Local Binary Patterns (LBP), and ResNet, adding multiple layers of feature richness. These features were combined into a comprehensive hybrid feature vector and analyzed using ML models, including Random Forest, XGBoost, and AdaBoost. The Random Forest model achieved an accuracy of 96%, while XGBoost obtained an accuracy of 95. 60%. AdaBoost reached an accuracy of 95%. The proposed method demonstrated significant improvements in detection accuracy and robustness, highlighting its effectiveness in enhancing skin cancer detection.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Interactive Game Simulation for Enhancing Child Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The proposed multi-agent interactive game simulation combines immersive storytelling with state-of-the-art language models as well as artificial intelligence (AI) characters that will help children to discover the enigmas behind derelict buildings reveal all its mysteries. The simulated personalities provide personalized advice which equips these little explorers with knowledge and security within an exciting virtual environment. Therefore, simulated dialogues between a kid and different characters found inside a dilapidated structure are created using the most advanced language types namely fine-tuned versions of Large Language Model (LLM). In their own unique ways each of the avatars in the game would give accurate direction or encouragement to the child. The design of AI system is put on a server that allows a seamless interaction between the child and virtual characters in real time. Their use of modern technologies empowers children select wisely while remaining secure in urban places. This proposed multi-agent interactive game simulation enhances child safety in derelict buildings by mimicking gameplay.

articleTitle: Automatic Normal/Infected Blood-Cell Analysis for Malaria Detection with Lightweight Deep-learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Malaria is a vector-borne disease and timely recognition and treatment is necessary to cure the patient. Untreated malaria will lead to various health illnesses, including death. Clinical level analysis of the malaria is commonly performed using the blood-teat and this research works proposed a computerized scheme for blood-cell analysis. The proposed research work consists the following phases; labeled image collection and resizing, feature extraction using a chosen Lightweight Deep-learning Model (LDM), performance evaluation using 3-fold cross validation and confirmation. This work also proposed Ensemble of Deep-features (EOD) based classification and achieved better detection accuracy. The merit of proposed tool is verified using; Conventional DeepFeatures (CDF) and the EOD using the SoftMax classifier and the achieved experimental results are compared and the merit of the developed scheme is confirmed. The outcome of this study confirms that the proposed approach helps to get an accuracy of 100% when the EOD based classification is executed. In the future, it can be considered to detect the blood cell infection from the microscopic images collected from hospitals.

articleTitle: Low-cost portable system for medical image visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Nowadays, medical images are a fundamental tool for the diagnosis and treatment of many diseases and ailments, thus requiring a considerable computational infrastructure, consisting of hardware and software; in hardwarese requires a processor of the latest generation accompanied by a graphic processing unit, which helps the visualization of the images. In relation to the necessary software, computer programs are required that can read, process and visualize the images in DICOM format, which is the standard format. In this work describe the use and exploitation of the Nvidia Tegra K1 development unit, being an embedded device with high computational capacity because it has a CPU and a GPU, which allows to work with different applications for the visualization of DICOM images, the present the configuration of the device as an integrated unit, The device can be used as a portable workstation, which would allow to perform field work in areas where there is no access to a health center, where health personnel can visit patients, which helps to diagnose and provide health services in remote populations. The device can perform multiple functionalities, depending on the program to be worked.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Disaster Data Calculation & SMS Alerting: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Natural disasters pose major threats to human life and infrastructure, necessitating the speedy and precise calculation of catastrophic data as well as effective alerting mechanisms to mitigate potential losses. Artificial intelligence (AI) discoveries have played a major role in altering disaster management strategies in recent years. This research study gives an overview of existing survey studies that investigate the usage of artificial intelligence-powered algorithms for disaster data processing and SMS notifications. Various AI-based methodologies, such as machine learning algorithms, deep learning models, and data fusion techniques, have been used to manage a variety of data sources, including satellite photos, remote sensors, and social media feeds. These AI-powered systems have demonstrated remarkable abilities in assessing disaster severity, estimating affected population density, and detecting severe infrastructure damage.

articleTitle: Legal documents Text Analysis using Natural Language Processing (NLP)
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: India’s judiciary system faces a significant backlog of cases, leading to delays in justice delivery. This research explores the potential of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to streamline legal processes and improve efficiency. By utilizing NLP capabilities such as information retrieval, encoding, sentiment analysis, and Optical Character Recognition (OCR), the proposed solution aims to automate the analysis of legal documents, reducing the workload on judges and lawyers. The study focuses on the application of topic modeling using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and text summarization using Transformers to extract key information and generate concise summaries of legal documents. Additionally, text KPIs visualization techniques can be employed to gain valuable insights from legal data. By integrating NLP into the legal system, it is anticipated that the efficiency of case processing can be significantly improved, leading to faster resolution of cases and a more equitable justice system.

articleTitle: Objective and Subjective Analysis of Audio Source Separation using GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The study centers on audio separation and conducts a thorough quality assessment through objective and subjective analysis. A key area of research in source separation is Blind Source Separation (BSS), which aims to estimate source signals from mixed signals with minimal information about the sources or the mixing process. Researchers have primarily utilized various signal processing techniques to address the source separation challenge. Recently, deep learning methods, especially those involving sound and image recognition, have shown significant effectiveness and have been applied in previous studies in this field. These networks employ various mathematical functions to aggregate multiple inputs, resulting in separated outputs. The model in this study was trained using audio samples from the Audio Source Separation Dataset, with training conducted through Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). The generated estimates were evaluated using various objective analysis methods designed for assessing audio signals. Experimental evaluations demonstrated the effectiveness of the approach through metrics such as Signal-to-Distortion Ratio (SDR), Signal-to-Interference Ratio (SIR), Signal-to-Artifacts Ratio (SAR), and Image-to-Signal Ratio (ISR).

articleTitle: AI for Career Growth: Advanced Resume Analysis and LinkedIn Scraping for Personalized Job Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In today’s dynamic job market, individuals seeking career advancement face the challenge of efficiently navigating through vast amounts of information to identify suitable job opportunities. To address this challenge, we present an innovative approach leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) technologies for career growth. Our system combines advanced resume analysis techniques with LinkedIn scraping capabilities to provide personalized job recommendations tailored to individual skillsets and career aspirations. The system uses an AI-powered resume analyser and Selenium based web scraping to extract key information from resumes. It uses natural language processing to identify strengths, weaknesses, qualifications, experience, and achievements, and Google Gemini AI Model to generate personalized job title recommendations. The system also extracts job listings from LinkedIn, enhancing the job search process. Experiments show the system improves efficiency and accuracy, enabling individuals to make informed career decisions and accelerate professional growth.

articleTitle: Optimizing Blister Detection With CNN-based Infrared Shape Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The present research employs texture analysis and a Convolutional Neural Network to discover anomalous temperature patterns related with plantar foot ulcers in diabetes patients. Diabetic foot ulcers are a serious health danger if not managed. The suggested approach distinguishes diabetic foot ulcers from healthy tissue based on their distinct textural properties. The study tries to accurately detect these ulcers based on their individual thermal textures by using multiple layers within a CNN model. The suggested method’s efficacy is assessed and compared to existing methodologies for identifying diabetic foot ulcers, revealing the possibility for earlier diagnosis and care in this essential health problem.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach of Black Widow Optimization with Firefly (FF) Algorithm for Efficient Routing in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The sensor nodes that make up a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) can be located anywhere and are linked wirelessly so that they can all keep tabs on the same set of physical characteristics in the area of interest. The nodes in a WSN run on internal batteries, thus when they run out of energy after repeated uses, the network has a shorter lifespan. Clustering and routing methods are frequently utilized in WSN to improve energy efficiency and network lifetime. For WSN’s cluster-based routing, this work introduces the innovative black widow optimization with firefly algorithm (FFA). The suggested BWO-FF algorithm comprises BWO based clustering procedure to elect an optimal set of cluster heads (CHs). The BWO algorithm creates a fitness function utilizing input parameters. In addition, route selection for inter-cluster communication requires an FF-based routing method. This routing method aims to enhance network throughput and lifetime by calculating the ideal route from each node to the sink in an effort to ensure uniform energy consumption across the network. MATLAB simulations have been used to analyze the proposed approach from several perspectives. The BWO-FF algorithm’s superiority to all other techniques studied is guaranteed by a selection of comparison evaluations.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi based Assistive Device for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Recent research reveals that 36 million individuals are entirely blind, while 217 million experience moderate to severe visual impairment (MSVI). Navigating daily life poses significant challenges for visually impaired individuals, necessitating the development of advanced assistive technologies. We introduce an innovative supportive device aimed at increasing the self-sufficiency of visually impaired individuals. This device integrates Optical Character Recognition (OCR), object detection, and door detection capabilities. It further employs a Raspberry Pi microcontroller along with a camera module to capture images, which are subsequently processed to deliver auditory feedback to the user. The OCR system converts printed text into speech using Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis, enabling users to access written information. The object detection module identifies and announces obstacles and landmarks, while the door detection module informs users about the status of doors, enhancing navigation and safety. Performance metrics such as precision, accuracy, recall, and F1 score were assessed, demonstrating the efficacy of each model. An 89% of accuracy was attained by the OCR model, while the object detection and door detection models recorded accuracies of 87.6% and 82%, respectively. Despite limitations such as restricted handwritten text recognition and limited computational power, the device offers a user-friendly and cost-effective solution for visually impaired individuals, promoting greater autonomy and ease in daily activities.

articleTitle: The Efficiency Duel - PI vs. FOPI Control: The Next Frontier in Solar PV Boost Converter System Optimisation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Renewable sources of energy and microgrids are advancing rapidly. Among the renewable sources of energy, solar is the most effective and widely amended. Standalone solar Photovoltaic (PV) systems generate very low DC voltage and require DC-DC converters powered by controllers to expediate their ideal characteristics. This paper aims to compare the fractional order proportional integral (FOPI) and proportional integral (PI) controllers using the particle swarm optimization (PSO) technique. From the frequency and time responses obtained, it has been found that the FOPI controller has the least rise time of 0.0231 s, while the highest was found to be $F O(P I)^{n}$, with a rise time of 0.0343 s.

articleTitle: Automatic Copra Quality Analyser using ESP-32 Camera Module
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In today’s agricultural landscape, ensuring the quality of copra remains a paramount concern for producers and consumers alike. To address this challenge, we propose a novel solution that leverages cutting-edge technology to automate the copra quality analysis process. By integrating components such as the ESP32 camera module, IR sensor, servo motor with a 3Dmodelled hand, and a conveyor belt driven by a wiper motor, our system aims to revolutionize the way copra quality is assessed. Through the seamless combination of these elements, we seek to provide a reliable, efficient, and cost-effective method for identifying and removing defective copra, ultimately enhancing overall productivity and profitability in the copra industry.

articleTitle: TrackTrust: Revolutionizing Supply Chain Management Through Blockchain Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research proposes a blockchain-based Supply Chain Management (SCM) system to enhance transparency, security, and traceability. The system integrates Manufacturers, Warehouse Owners, Retailers, and Customers on a unified platform overseen by an Admin. Key innovations include unique QR codes for product tracking and smart contracts for automated transactions. Manufacturers add products with QR codes storing critical information. Customers browse and purchase products through a user interface, initiating blockchain-recorded transactions. The supply chain process encompasses stages like Manufacturer sale, Warehouse IN/OUT, and Retailer IN/OUT. Customers can verify product authenticity using QR codes. Smart contracts automate payment distribution among participants based on predefined rules. The system demonstrates improved visibility, data integrity, and operational efficiency. Benefits include enhanced traceability, security, and trust among stakeholders. Our research showcases blockchain’s potential to address realworld SCM challenges, offering a scalable solution for modern supply chain needs.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Autonomous Antenna for Vehicle to Vehicle Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Internet technology advancements have significantly improved transportation by updating traffic patterns on maps. This is achieved through Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication using small antennas in cars to exchange information. Nonetheless, the majority of antenna designs for V2V communication use dipole antenna array. Based on this, a fractal dipole based triangular-shaped antenna array was modelled with resonance at 5.7 GHz, a frequency suited for vehicular communication, was proposed in this article. Here, the triangular shaped dipole antenna was first analyzed. Then, it connected in series to form an antenna array. The simulation analysis showed that both the antenna achieved higher efficiency of 86% for dipole antenna and 94% for antenna array at its resonant frequency of 5.7 GHz. This shows that the proposed antenna structure is best for the vehicle to vehicle communication.

articleTitle: Design of Robust Control System for Paint and Coating Process
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Paint & Coating industries have displayed a significant role in a variety of areas e.g. aerospace, construction, and automotive applications. However, a big challenge that has been associated with this process is the precise control of coating process for ensuring high-quality finishes maintaining consistent uniformity and thickness. The conventional control strategies can’t give promising results due to uncertainties and nonlinearities existing in these processes. This research is exploring the potential of H infinity control in enhancing the performance and robustness of control system for a considered second-order paint & coating process model. For this model, a conventional PID controller, and a H-infinity based controller have been designed using MATLAB. The improvement in the control performance by H -infinity technique has been highlighted by comparing it with the conventional PID control system in terms of various time domain and frequency domain parameters.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid TLBO-RAT Algorithm for Optimal and Cost-Effective Power Generation Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research addresses the Economic Load Dispatch (ELD) problem in power systems by proposing an innovative hybrid approach, integrating the Teaching-Learning-Based Optimization (TLBO) and Rat-in-aTube (RAT) algorithm. Applied to the IEEE 14-bus and IEEE 30-bus systems, the methodology optimizes generator output levels while considering constraints like capacity limits and transmission line losses. Leveraging TLBO’s teaching and learning phases and RAT’s exploration-exploitation trade-off enhancement, the hybrid algorithm demonstrates superior performance in achieving optimal or near-optimal ELD solutions. Using realistic parameters, results showcase faster convergence and higher solution quality compared to traditional optimization methods. This study contributes a powerful hybrid algorithm for ELD, offering valuable insights for efficient and sustainable economic load dispatch in intricate power networks. To differentiate from conventional optimization approaches, the proposed algorithm’s performance is evaluated through comparative analyses. These evaluations emphasize the algorithm’s advantageous characteristics concerning the speed of convergence and the quality of solutions, showcasing its effectiveness in comparison to established methods in the field. This research contributes to the field of power system optimization by introducing a hybrid algorithm that integrates the strengths of TLBO and RAT to address the ELD problem.

articleTitle: Assessing the Efficacy of CNN-SVM Hybrids in Breast Tumor Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Advanced diagnostic techniques are required to ensure that breast cancer is diagnosed right from the time it begins to manifest and is one of the leading causes of illness and death among women worldwide. The work in this research describes a dual model of CNN and SVM to improve the detection of breast tumors. The model underwent evaluation utilizing datasets from five distinct customers, each consisting of photos classified into five categories: benign is used to refer to conditions that are not dangerous, malignant is used to refer to cancerous conditions, cystic is an abnormal sac-like structure, and fibroadenoma is an abnormal breast tissue growth and finally normal refers to a healthy status. The hybrid model yielded the best results with an average accuracy of 95 percent, with most analyzed parameters giving satisfactory performance results. 64%, and the Gig Economy software solution accuracy of 98.4%, and the accuracy of the feature selection model is 86—$6 \%$. The hybrid model caused enhancements in the precision and recall ratio, as demonstrated in the different charts throughout the manuscript. In particular, it showed 94 percent accuracy in predictions related to newscasts. 8% Their acceptability level stands at 8%, while the recall level of the brand was $94 \% .5 \%$. The former CNN model obtained a higher precision of about $91: 8 \% ~\&$ a recall of 91%. The first model achieved an accuracy of 2%, while the other one, the SVM model, achieved a precision of 87.9%, While the precision for the second search strategy was 83.5%. The tests for client-model correspondence confirmed the model’s stability during the analysis, which resulted in an accuracy rate of 94.5% to 95. ${7 \%}$ across several datasets.

articleTitle: Enhanced Diagnostic Precision in Knee Osteoarthritis: Leveraging MobileNetV2 for Deep Learning Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Osteoarthritis, a type of arthritis worldwide, affects millions of Americans by breaking down the protective cartilage that cushions the ends of the bones, most especially in joints of the hands, knees, hips, and spine. In this progressive condition of joint wear and tear, one usually experiences pain, stiffness, swelling, loss of function and sometimes disability that interferes with activities and work performance. The study talks about the identification of osteoarthritis through MobileNetV3. It is a state-of-the-art neural network structure based on device blocks. The model gives an accuracy of 82.94% for the loss of 0.37498 in the test. Precision Depending upon the case, it was 0.75, and for osteoarthritis cases, it was 0.89. Its overall recall is 0.83, as its F1 score is 0.79 in cases and 0.86 for osteoarthritis cases. The average precision scorings, both the macro and weighted recall rates, and F1 scores were approximately 0.82 to 0.83, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of MobileNetV3 concerning the classifications of osteoarthritis that might be used early in detection and treatment management.

articleTitle: Enhancing Conversational AI with LLMs for Customer Support Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into customer support systems offers transformative potential for improving the efficiency and quality of service interactions. As businesses increasingly rely on digital communication channels, the demand for responsive and accurate customer support escalates. LLMs, with their advanced natural language processing capabilities, provide a promising solution to meet these demands by automating responses and handling a large volume of queries simultaneously without compromising the personalization expected by customers.This research introduces a novel method that leverages the capabilities of LLMs specifically tailored for customer support scenarios. The method involves a hybrid architecture that combines traditional LLM frameworks with custom-trained models, a corpus of real-world customer service interactions on Twitter. This approach is designed to enhance the model’s ability to understand context, manage conversational states, and generate responses that are not only accurate but also contextually appropriate.The implementation of this novel method was rigorously evaluated on the dataset, with a focus on metrics such as response accuracy, contextual relevance, and customer satisfaction indicators. The results demonstrated significant improvements over baseline models, showcasing enhanced response generation capabilities. Key findings include a marked increase in the model’s ability to resolve queries in fewer interaction rounds and its enhanced capability to adapt responses based on the customer’s sentiment and query complexity.By bridging the gap between theoretical LLM architectures and practical, scalable applications for customer support, this research contributes to the ongoing evolution of conversational AI. The implications of this study are profound, suggesting that LLMs can not only automate but also enrich the customer support experience, thereby supporting businesses in maintaining high standards of customer service in the digital age.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cloud Infrastructure Management Using Large Language Models: A DevOps Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Traditional methods often struggle to keep pace with the dynamic nature of cloud resources, necessitating more intelligent and adaptable solutions. This study proposes the integration of large language models (LLMs) into cloud infrastructure management, providing a novel perspective on automating and optimizing DevOps tasks. Our research primarily focuses on enhancing predictive maintenance, resource allocation, and system scalability through the deployment of LLMs.The methodology hinges on the adaptation of LLMs to interpret and respond to cloud management tasks, including real-time decision-making and predictive analytics. Using the Google Cluster Usage traces as a dataset, which details job and task usage across compute clusters, we model various scenarios pertinent to load balancing and system failures. The experiments are designed to measure the impact of LLMs on key performance metrics such as downtime reduction, resource utilization, and operational costs.Preliminary results indicate that LLMs can significantly improve the predictive accuracy of system anomalies and optimize resource allocation. The models demonstrate robustness in managing complex cloud environments, leading to notable enhancements in infrastructure efficiency and reliability. This study not only validates the feasibility of using LLMs for cloud management tasks but also highlights their potential to transform traditional DevOps practices. Further discussions in this paper explore the practical implications of our findings, address the limitations of current approaches, and propose directions for future research. This research contributes to the burgeoning field of AI in cloud computing, offering insights that could lead to more sustainable and scalable cloud management solutions.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Energy Conservation in Demand Side Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The primary research goal of the study is to build a management system for energy resources, particularly in micro-grids, which is utilized to improve energy consumption technique and management using renewable energy resources in order to produce a system that is affordable. Current developments in power grid and micro-grid technology include concepts for energy congestion and smart grid distributed generation. Due to the fact that these qualities are particularly helpful in increasing energy efficiency and lowering costs associated with new power plants, etc. In accordance with shifting load to offpeak periods from peak periods, demand side management will offer a solution for energy conservation that is both practical and affordable. And that in-turn reducing the many environmental impacts which is caused by using the conventional power resources which is used in smart grids helps in achieving the economic sustainability and addressing the effective energy demand are the main critical characteristics of demand side management systems. The various implementations for the demands like management and that algorithm safe for the future use for the monitoring purpose. By this search it is been analyzed that the production in the network congestion, improvement in power factor and average speed ratio with ultimately increases the unbalance in the grid.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Emergency Valve Automation System for Screen Printing Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In industries like screen printing, precise chemical mixing is crucial for optimal results. However, traditional manual methods can lead to inconsistencies and errors. To address this challenge, we propose an IoT-enabled Emergency Valve Automation System. By leveraging IoT technology, this system enables remote monitoring and control of valves, ensuring accurate and consistent chemical mixing. The system automates the process of mixing chemicals such as paint or ink, minimizing human error and improving efficiency. This innovative solution contributes to enhanced safety and reliability in chemical mixing processes, ultimately leading to improved product quality and reduced operational costs.

articleTitle: EmotiveNet: Advancing Facial Expression Recognition with CNN-Random Forest Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research paper examines the performance of a hybrid machine learning model combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Random Forest classifiers for classifying 10 distinct categories. Utilizing a confusion matrix, this study assessed the model’s accuracy, identifying high performance in specific classes while pinpointing challenges in distinguishing between others. The findings reveal the model’s strengths in learning complex patterns and weaknesses in areas prone to misclassification. Future enhancements will focus on refining the model through advanced feature engineering, expanding training datasets, and exploring innovative machine-learning techniques to improve accuracy and reliability, aiming for broader applicability in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Sentiment Analysis: Combining CNN and LSTM for Enhanced Performance on Facebook Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research evaluates the effectiveness of different sentiment analysis techniques, especially the hybrid CNN-LSTM model, on a large dataset of 100,000 Facebook posts and comments. For accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score evaluation, many metrics are in use for comparison with the traditional machine learning models (Naive Bayes, SVM) and other deep learning models such as the standalone CNN and LSTM vis-à-vis the CNN-LSTM model. The CNN-LSTM model showed the highest performances across all metrics: accuracy of 0.91, precision of 0.90, recall of 0.90, and an F1 score of 0.90. Detailed error analysis has shown the problems in sarcasm detection and, to a small extent, the detection of subtly formulated sentiment, while confusion matrix analysis also shows that the neutral class has systematically been mislabeled as positive or negative. These findings point out possible areas one needs to look at for improvements by the inclusion of attention mechanisms. The results of this study emphasize the CNN-LSTM model’s practical applicability to customer feedback analysis, brand monitoring, and market research. Advanced techniques and diverse datasets can be used in further research to improve the robustness of the model and its generalizability.

articleTitle: Monitoring the Water Extraction Changes and Land Surface Temperature
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Monitoring the LST and Water Extraction presents a comprehensive analysis of the impact of water extraction on land surface temperature (LST) in Kanigiri Mandal, India, leveraging Sentinel satellite data and Google Earth Engine processing capabilities. By employing the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) for water extraction and LST retrieval, the study offers valuable insights into the temporal trends and spatial patterns of LST dynamics from 2019 to 2022. Such insights are crucial for diverse applications, ranging from land management and agriculture to environmental monitoring and planning. The findings of land surface temperature hold significant implications for sustainable development and resource management strategies in the region. By understanding the relationship between water extraction activities and LST fluctuations, stakeholders can better assess the potential impacts on agricultural productivity, water availability, and ecosystem health. Moreover, the insights gained from the study can aid in formulating effective drought assessment and mitigation plans, providing decision-makers with valuable information to address the challenges posed by changing environmental conditions. Overall, the research contributes to advancing our understanding of the complex interactions between human activities and environmental dynamics, thereby facilitating informed decision- making processes for sustainable development and resilience- building efforts in Kanigiri Mandal and similar regions

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Loan Prediction for Banking Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The primary offering of bankers and other financial organisations is loans. Due to the fact that more individuals are using banks for borrowing money for a variety of purposes, the number of clients has expanded, and some banks anticipate making large profits from the interest that is paid on loans. But there is a chance that a loan will be repaid. Thus, a large percentage of non-performing loans has the potential to cause instability in the banking industry and ultimately result in bankruptcy. Verifying that the borrower has the ability to repay the loan within the suggested terms is a crucial stage in the process by which banks determine whether to approve a loan. The development of technology, including computer science, machine learning, and other fields of study, is crucial because it enables banks to forecast a customer’s likelihood of defaulting based on his prior conduct. Once the machine was trained using its training dataset, we verified the accuracy of various models using the test dataset. In order to determine which machine learning approaches are optimal for forecasting bank loan default, SVM is conducted (Support Vector Machines) is a powerful machine learning algorithm commonly used for classification tasks, including predicting loan default. Its ability to handle both linear and non-linear data makes it suitable for complex datasets encountered in banking. SVM works by finding the optimal hyperplane that separates data points into different classes, maximizing the margin between them. By leveraging SVM, banks can effectively classify borrowers into low-risk and high-risk categories, enabling them to make more informed lending decisions.

Author Keywords: Machine Learning for Learning and Prediction

articleTitle: Malware Classification through Opcodes using Deep Learning RNN and CNN models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study proposes a novel method for classifying malware using opcode sequences extracted from Windows files. Deep learning models such as RNN, LSTM, GRU, and a hybrid CNN-LSTM architecture are employed to achieve this. A dataset consisting of 500 malware samples from VirusShare and 500 non malware programs from GitHub was gathered. The collected samples were disassembled using IDA Pro to obtain opcode sequences, which were then processed to capture the execution patterns relevant to malware detection. The RNN, LSTM, GRU, and CNN-LSTM models were trained on these sequences to identify differences between malicious and benign software. Results shown that deep learning models, particularly the CNN-LSTM hybrid, significantly improve classification accuracy. The CNN-LSTM model achieved 98.5% accuracy, surpassing the RNN, LSTM, and GRU models, which recorded accuracies of $95 \%, 96.5 \%$, and $96 \%$, respectively. These findings highlight the potential of deep learning, especially CNN-LSTM, as an effective and scalable approach for detecting evolving malware threat.

articleTitle: A YOLO-based Object Detection Model for Counting the Number of Mathematical Expressions and Symbols
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In this research study, YOLO-based object detection is proposed, the main objective of which is to accurately count math symbols and formulas in technical and instructional texts. Thus, the principal purpose is to employ the most advanced machine learning algorithms to detect such characteristics more effectively and accurately. This model uses the YOLO (You Only Look Once) architecture to achieve superior results in real-time detection tasks. Thus, the general accuracy rate for all the tests except that of the writers’ feedback was 95%. Based on the YOLO model the suggested access strategy is significantly higher than existing approaches in existing positions. Better and faster processing combined with increased detection capabilities speak about the benefits of using the methodology based on YOLO, and that’s Education in development this enhancement is immensely useful for professionals, researchers, and educators who read technical texts.

articleTitle: Spam Message Identification Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Spam message detection has become an essential task in modern digital communication systems due to the exponential growth of unsolicited messages. Traditional rule-based spam filters, though initially effective, have become inadequate in handling the sophisticated techniques employed by spammers. Consequently, machine learning algorithms are used for spam detection because of their ability to learn the data and these algorithms can improve their performance by providing new data. This research paper explores various ML algorithms utilized for spam detection. Supervised learning methods are predominantly highlighted, focusing on how these models are trained using labeled datasets where messages are classified as spam or non-spam. Additionally, the paper addresses challenges such as the evolving nature of spam, imbalanced datasets, and the need for real-time detection solutions. The paper concludes by exploring the outcome results of ML models for spam detection with Support Vector Classifier (SVC) as best ML model with 97.48% accuracy.

articleTitle: AI-based Web App for Automated Direct Assessment of Learning Report Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In the academic evaluation process, manually entering marks from evaluated answer booklets into Excel sheets is time-consuming and error-prone. Accurate and efficient mark identification is crucial, as it directly affects student grade reporting. To address this issue, this project proposes a novel system for handwritten digit recognition leveraging OCR and CNN to generate Excel sheets with recognized digits. Existing OCR-based systems face challenges in handling diverse handwriting styles and require extensive pre-processing, leading to errors. The proposed system pre-processes images and utilizes CNN for feature extraction, predicting digits with high accuracy. The recognized digits are then organized into Excel sheets using the Openpyxl library these sheets provide structured data that can be directly used in Outcome-Based Education assessments and the generation of Faculty Course Assessment Reports. This facilitates more efficient analysis of student performance, identification of learning gaps, and implementation of targeted improvements, ultimately enhancing the reliability of the evaluation process

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency of Crop Recommendation using Incremental Rank-based Feature Selection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Traditional crop cultivation depends on the farmer’s choice, but nowadays, for suggesting suitable crops, a crop recommendation system is required for facilitating optimal crop yield predictions. This study investigates the effectiveness of an innovative approach, named as Incremental rank-based feature selection method, which can improvise the accuracy and efficiency of recommendation systems. Existing feature selection methods often stuck with the high-dimensional dataset as it is more complex. In contrast, proposed method systematically ranks and selects features based on their relevance to crop yield.
