The proposed approach leverages Self-Attention-Based Progressive Generative Adversarial Networks (SA-PGAN) optimized with the Gorilla Troops Optimizer (GTO) to accurately recognize subtle facial cues associated with ASD. The model is trained on a dataset of facial images from autistic children, undergoing extensive preprocessing to ensure data quality and consistency. The performance of the proposed model is evaluated using various metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and computational time. The results demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods, such as Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). This research contributes to the development of advanced AI-powered tools for early ASD detection, enabling timely interventions and improving the quality of life for individuals with ASD.

articleTitle: Adaptive LSTM Forecasting for RO Membrane Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The proposed research focuses on adaptive forecasting to predict faults in Reverse Osmosis (RO) membranes, crucial for maintaining water treatment efficiency and system longevity. By leveraging Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks integrated with Adaptive Windowing (ADWIN) drift detection, the system dynamically adjusts to changes in membrane performance over time. This approach enables real-time monitoring and forecasting of membrane health through sensors that provide continuous data on the RO water quality. Early detection of potential faults is ensured before they compromise system operation which also affects the human health. Additionally, the system’s adaptability allows it to be effectively utilized in various locations with different water qualities, making it versatile for diverse environmental conditions. This method represents a significant advancement in proactive maintenance strategies for RO systems, contributing to more reliable and efficient water purification processes.

articleTitle: Vehicle Classification and Accident Avoidance in Hill Station ising CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Vehicle classification and accident avoidance in hill stations is an important problem that can be solved using computer vision techniques and machine learning algorithms. The proposed system consists of an intelligent camera system that can classify vehicles based on their type and detect potential collisions with other vehicles or obstacles on the road. The system is built using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm for vehicle classification, (RF) encoder and decoder for feature extraction, and an Arduino Uno microcontroller for Alerting the vehicle. In the existing system, vehicle classification and accident avoidance are typically done manually by the driver, which is not always reliable, especially in hilly terrain. The proposed system overcomes this limitation by automating the process using advanced computer vision and deep learning algorithms. The proposed system uses a web camera using vehicle images in the mountain to capture real-time images of the road ahead. Then processed using a CNN algorithm for vehicle classification, which can identify various types of vehicles, such as cars, buses. The system uses an RF encoder and decoder to extract features from the images and classify the vehicles accurately. Once a vehicle is classified, the system checks for potential collisions with other vehicles or obstacles on the road. If a potential collision is detected, the system sends a signal to the Arduino Uno microcontroller, which alert the vehicle to avoid the collision.

articleTitle: Enhancing Fashion Trend Predictions with XAICNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This study analyzes the Explainable AI-enabled Convolutional Neural Network (XAI-CNN) model for image trend analysis and classification. It is mainly aimed at increasing the interpretability and prediction performance of model predictions. We built two XAI-CNN models embedding Saliency Maps and Grad-CAM to explain our model visually. As a result of these experiments, the XAI-CNN models show markedly higher accuracy than a Baseline CNN model. More specifically, the Baseline CNN and XAI-CNN model with Saliency Maps had an accuracy of 85% only while the one using Grad-CAM achieved a top performance touching on almost $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$. These findings emphasize the importance of using explainable AI methods to improve model accuracy as well as interpretability. The visual explanations provided by the XAICNN models reveal important knowledge regarding what contributes to fashion trends, flowing back to related industries and stakeholders to assist their decisions. This study shows the relevance of BI in AI models as a whole, especially those where interpretability becomes one urgent requirement. Further investigations are recommended that can use other XAI techniques and multimodal data to improve the prediction performance of IPR-HRCT APWH while providing more interpretable results.

articleTitle: Multisensory Approach for Stopped Vehicle Detection on Highways to Enhance Collision Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Road accidents caused by stopped vehicles pose a significant threat to road safety. Traditional detection systems, often relying on single-sensor technologies, suffer from limitations such as poor performance in adverse weather conditions and high false positive rates. This research presents a novel multisensory detection system designed to improve the accuracy and reliability of detecting stopped vehicles on highways. By combining multiple sensor modalities, the system effectively overcomes the limitations of individual sensors. Experimental results demonstrate that the multisensory approach surpasses traditional radar and camera-based systems, achieving a remarkable detection accuracy of $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$. This significant improvement can contribute to a significant reduction in accidents caused by stopped vehicles. The proposed multisensory detection system offers a promising solution for enhancing road safety and improving traffic management systems.

articleTitle: The Future of Orthopedic Care: High-Accuracy Bone Fracture Detection with CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Bone fractures are a severe health issue and affect millions of people across the globe. Their diagnosis must thus be timely and correct for appropriate treatment. Conventional diagnosis of bone fracture is mainly done through manual examination of radiographic evidence on X-rays, and hence, it suffers from variability. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a deep learning-based approach for classifying bone fractures using convolutional neural networks. The training and validation of our model were performed on a dataset of 399 labeled X-ray images aggregated into classes “fracture” and “non-fracture”. The proposed CNN model demonstrated excellent performance, with results up to $98 \%$ in overall accuracy. Based on the report of classification, outcomes for the non-fracture class were: precision is 0.99, recall is 0.97, F1-score is 0.98, support is 199; for the class of fracture: precision is 0.97, recall is 0.99, F1-score is 0.98, support is 200; and the average for macro and weighted for precision, recall, and F1-score came out to be 0.98 for both classes, indicating the model’s ability and robustness. These results are evident for the great potential of CNN-based models in automating the detection of bone fractures to enhance the diagnostic process and probably improve patient outcomes through quicker, more accurate diagnosis. In the future, this research work will further explore the implementation of this model in clinical setups and estimate the performances on larger, more diverse datasets.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach to Fashion product Recommendation and Classification: Leveraging Transfer Learning and ANNOY
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Fashion recommendation systems have become indispensable for modern e-commerce platforms, aiming to deliver personalized product suggestions that enhance user satisfaction. However, the dynamic nature of fashion trends, coupled with the vast and complex landscape of fashion images, presents significant challenges for traditional recommendation approaches. This research introduces a novel hybrid framework that effectively addresses these challenges. By integrating deep learning techniques, specifically the EfficientNetB0 model, for robust feature extraction and the Annoy (Approximate Nearest Neighbors Oh Yeah) library for efficient similarity search, the system demonstrates superior performance in generating accurate and timely fashion recommendations. This approach effectively captures the intricate patterns within fashion data, leading to improved user engagement and satisfaction. Apart from the fashion recommendation, the proposed model is also capable of multi-class classification of the products with a validation accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9. 7 9} \%$ and a validation loss of 4.8%.

articleTitle: Automatic Brain Tumour Detection using MRI Slice with MobileNet: An Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Computerized disease examination is a common clinical practice and examination of the medical-data based mental-health using chosen algorithm is widely adopted in multispecialty hospitals. This process will considerably reduce the diagnostic time found in the traditional mental-health screening practice. This research aims to develop a deep-learning (DL) technique to detect the Brain Tumour (BT) in chosen Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) database. This work employs the MobileNetV1 and MobilenetV2 models to detect the BT with improved accuracy. To increase the detection results, this work proposes feature reduction using $\mathbf{5 0 \%}$ dropout and features fusion. Then the merit of the develop system is confirmed using the binary classification with a 3 -fold cross validation. Initially, the classification is performed using the SoftMax and then the conventional classifiers widely adopted in the machine-learning approaches are also considered. The outcome confirms that this technique helps to achieve a detection accuracy of 99.5% with the chosen scheme. This confirms that the proposed technique works well on the chosen MRI database.

articleTitle: Transforming Pharmacological Research: Utilizing AI and Machine Learning in Drug Discovery and Development
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In the past few years, the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in health systems has risen continuously. The rapid advancement of AI has revolutionized the area of experimental pharmacology and drug discovery. It enables efficient analysis of vast datasets, aids in drug discovery to real-world data mining, enhances predictive modeling, accelerates the recognition of probable drug candidates, optimizes drug design and helps in target identification. Furthermore, algorithms for machine learning can examine complex biological interactions and offer insightful information about drug mechanisms and toxicity. Integrating AI into pharmacology research not only accelerates the process of developing drugs but also contributes to more precise and effective therapeutic interventions. In post-marketing inspection/ pharmacovigilance, AI is used to observe adverse drug reactions, find out drug interactions, design clinical research, and contribute to pharmacovigilance efforts by applying its different AI-based tools. Machine learning (ML) models extract patterns from complex data records, produce correct results and help in resolution, because of their potential to accelerate drug discovery. In this investigation, we will discuss the basics of AI, innovative research and development in AI methods followed by the benefits of AI in pharmacology research as well as clinical practice. This study will demonstrate AI and ML-driven key challenges in the advancements of therapeutic development and drug discovery.

articleTitle: Advancements in Kidney Disease Diagnosis: The Role of Deep Learning Techniques in Modern Medicine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The detection of kidney diseases is essential for early clinical intervention and effective therapy. In this paper, a classification model is described for detecting four types of kidney conditions: normal, cyst, tumor, and stone. This model was applied by training a convolutional neural network on a diverse dataset to detect a high degree of accuracy and reliability. The performance metrics of the model for classification are evaluated in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. For class Cyst, the model obtained a precision of 89.64%, a recall of 88.56%, and an F1-score of 89.10% with the support of 556 instances. The Normal class obtained metrics with an accuracy of 90.00%, a recall of 89.87%, and an F1-score of $\mathbf{8 9. 9 3 \%}$ across the support of 762 cases. Lastly, on the Stone class, the model added a precision of 86.26%, a recall of 89.52%, and an F1-score of 87.86% from the 207 instances. Tumor class: $\mathbf{9 0. 0 0 \%}$ precision, recall, and $F 1$-score for 342 instances. It achieved an accuracy of 90.46% on 1867 instances in total. Its macro average precision, recall, and F1-score were 88.97%, 89.49%, and 89.22%, respectively, while the weighted average precision, recall, and F1-score were $89.48 \%, 89.46 \%$, and $\mathbf{8 9. 4 7 \%}$. Most importantly, these results demonstrate that this proposed classification approach is very practical for diagnosis concerning kidney diseases and thus greatly aids the medical fraternity in clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: Revolutinoning AI: Artificial Intelligence Based Crypto Currency Farm Mining Application Design Using Federated Deep Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In this research, an artificial intelligence cryptocurrency mining application using federated deep learning introduced. Federated Learning Framework for Edge Computing The solution mitigates the issue of decentralized data processing, privacy preserving, and latency reduction via a practical federated learning framework. The core of the system is a mixed deep learning model utilizing ResNet50 and SqueezeNet architectures, jointly rendering high accuracy with low computational cost. Taking the federated learning framework as an example, a central server and multiple client nodes are set up, dividing secure communication protocols to ensure integrity of data. Several custom federated learning algorithms were implemented to adjust the decentralized nature of crypto-jacking for local training on client nodes and central server diffusion of model updates. The hybrid model provides a high level of performance in terms of optimizing mining operations with an accuracy rate of $\mathbf{9 6. 2 5 \%}$. This model stored countless data such as hash rates, power consumption and network data that mining activity produced, thus making it possible for the mining strategy to be constantly updated. By integrating the model with mine application various interfaces was developed with user-friendly features, thereby facilitating ease in monitoring and control of mining operations.

articleTitle: A Robust Development of Superficial Learning Model for Employee Layoff Prediction using Artificial Intelligence Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In today’s business environment, predicting employee layoffs is a challenging task to maintain both operational efficiency and employee morale. Traditional methods proved insufficient in terms of precision and dependability, this is the reason why new predictive models have been forged. The proposed Employee Layoff Prediction model uses Hybrid Neuro Classifier (HNC), combining the advantages of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and artificial neural networks (ANNs) to improve prediction accuracy. The proposed HNC model extends LeNet CNN to perform automatic capturing of complex patterns and spatial hierarchies in the data using its deep feature extraction capabilities. The extracted features are then fed into cascaded ANNs where refinements produced with the aid of learning deep intricate dependencies enable delicate representations. Since this hybrid approach combines the refinement needed to tune sentences applied in grounded experiments and additionally can effectively generalize over large amounts accurately labeled data, it offers predictive accuracy. The implementation of the HNC model was built and trained models with Python using libraries. Experimental results show that the proposed method can accurately predict employee layoffs with $\mathbf{9 7. 8 1 \%}$ accuracy.

articleTitle: A Novel Privacy enabled Human Health and Safety Monitoring System using IoT with Smart Wearable Device
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Human health encompasses physical, mental, and social well-being, requiring a holistic approach to maintain and improve. Modern health monitoring leverages the Internet of Things (IoT) to provide real-time data on vital signs, transforming healthcare practices. These devices transmit data to healthcare providers or store it in cloud systems for trend analysis, allowing for proactive health management. The advent of IoT technology has revolutionized the healthcare sector, particularly in monitoring and ensuring human health and safety. This research study presents a novel privacy-enabled human health and safety monitoring system using IoT with smart wearable devices. The proposed system integrates wearable sensors, gateway devices, an IoT cloud platform, and mobile/web applications to provide continuous, real-time monitoring of vital health metrics. The system ensures data privacy and security through homomorphic encryption, blockchain-based access control, and multi-factor authentication. Comparative analysis demonstrates the system’s superior performance in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and data security, achieving an accuracy rate of up to 97% in anomaly detection.

articleTitle: Enhancing Predictive Model Performance through Comprehensive Pre-processing and Hybrid Feature Selection: A Study using SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)

authors.preferredName: N S Koti Mani Kumar Tirumanadham

abstract: This study aims to achieve the improved performance of heart disease prediction based on the increased level of preprocessing and rather effective feature selection approaches. Starting with data preparation in which the data is first cleaned up the work develops a class balance solution using Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) while the Z-score function identifies outliers. As it will be described in CHAN section that applies Chi-square and ANOVA under a hybrid model, the useful characteristics for model training are identified and prioritized. Using a method derived from the medical records database, the study focuses on the heart health indices using Support Vector Machines (SVM) which is a modelling technique widely known for its effectiveness in handling increased numbers of variables and the relationship between the measurements. Measures such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score among others are used in the evaluation of the success of the approach. In particular, the results shed the light to Health Care applications where risk assessment and correct diagnosis is extremely critical; the findings also assert the important roles of strong preprocessing and selective feature selection strategies in enhancing the predictive model’s performance. This work contributes to the development of approaches intended for stable and efficient modelling in medical decision support system.

Author Keywords: Heart disease and Support Vector Machine

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of EHO and GWO Optimization Techniques for PI Controller Tuning of Boost Converter in Photovoltaic based Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Boost converters are essential for microgrid systems, facilitating the systematic integration of renewable energy systems and also ensuring efficient energy conversion and reducing voltage mismatches that may occur due to faults, leading to instability and issues in power quality. Closed loop Proportionalintegral (PI) control of the boost converter is crucial to moderate the terminal output voltage of the boost converter according to the application. The main aim of this manuscript is to optimize these PI values to have a more efficient boost converter operation for microgrids. Optimization techniques like elephant herding optimization (EHO) and grey wolf optimization (GWO) have been investigated to obtain a better value of the PI controller for boost converter control and compared with PI controller values obtained by traditional auto tuning. The step response analysis to compare the rise times, peak times, and peak values is performed to have a better comparison between these techniques. Rise time and peak time are approximately 10% and 8% less in the case of GWO compared to EHO, much higher in the case of auto tuning. Also, a comparison regarding different error indices like integral absolute error (IAE), integral of squared error (ISE), and integral time absolute error (ITAE) has been made among these optimization techniques along with the traditional autotuning method through simulation, which will pave the way to choosing a better optimization technique to have an efficient PI controller value and, in turn, an efficient operation of the boost converter for microgrid applications.

articleTitle: Implementing Agile Task Management System: Leveraging Web Development and Power BI for Enhanced Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Developing a Task management system can benefit organizations in several ways which offers a comprehensive solution that enhances productivity, improves collaboration, provides visibility, supports Agile practices, ensures accountability, and allows for seamless integration and scalability. This helps organizations manage their tasks and projects more efficiently, ultimately leading to better outcomes and increased success. The Agile Task Management system can be developed by combining both the front-end and back-end along with a database for storing and organizing the company project details like the status, project timeline, and project team details like their mail IDs and the particular projects they belong to. The task management web application can be developed in various languages and frameworks for managing and aggregating projects with specific employees. This research study focuses on two main areas: developing a task management web application and creating a dashboard using Power BI for in-depth analysis of the organization’s project dataset. Power BI plays a crucial role in data analytics by integrating data from multiple sources, enabling interactive exploration, and facilitating collaborative decision-making through its powerful visualization and reporting tools. The discussion includes using HTML, JavaScript, Ajax, and Bootstrap for the front end, PHP for the backend, and MySQL for the database to create a comprehensive Task Management web application. Additionally, it covers the development of a simple task management system with a Python Flask application using SQL Alchemy and PyQt5 for GUI creation with an SQLite database. Additionally, the system is designed to handle complete project-related datasets by incorporating Power BI Desktop to create interactive dashboards for visualizing project data which is a separate part of the task management system.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Image using Enhanced Deep Residual Networks and the DIV2K Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Recent advances in deep learning have significantly improved the performance of super-resolution (SR) techniques, yet challenges persist in balancing image quality and computational efficiency. This paper presents a novel approach utilizing Enhanced Deep Residual Networks (EDRN) to effectively address these challenges. Utilizing the high-quality and diverse DIV2K dataset, this method employs a combination of Mean Squared Error (MSE) and perceptual loss functions to achieve an optimal balance between pixel accuracy and perceptual quality. Comprehensive evaluation using metrics like Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) demonstrates that the proposed EDRN consistently outperforms baseline models, such as SRCNN, VDSR, and EDSR, by delivering superior detail restoration and minimizing patterns. Visual comparisons further indicate the enhanced quality of the super-resolved images, making this approach a valuable asset for high-resolution imaging applications.

articleTitle: Detection and Prevention of Cyber Threats in Smart Cities Using Machine Learning and Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The increasing interconnectedness of smart cities has led to a surge in cyber threats. This research investigates the application of machine learning (ML) techniques to bolster the security of smart city environments. A comprehensive systematic literature review was conducted to analyze the effectiveness of various ML methodologies in detecting and preventing cyberattacks, including intrusions, malware, and spam. The study highlights the crucial role of ML in strengthening the security infrastructure of smart cities. By combining quantitative and qualitative research methods, this study explores the impact of ML-based intrusion detection systems on network traffic, expert opinions, and user interactions. The analysis involves employing statistical techniques, mathematical modeling, and ML algorithms to identify patterns and trends in the data. The findings of this research contribute to the advancement of cybersecurity in smart cities, enabling the development of more robust and resilient defense mechanisms.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Image Record Security via CNN-based Tamper Detection, Watermarking, and Digital Signatures
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Computers have been seamlessly integrated into every domain including health care where one of its applications is in the storage of health care records such as medical images. Electronic healtheare records contain a lot of sensitive information about patients, such as the diseases, diagnosis, treatment plans, drugs administered or medicines prescribed and hence this vital information must not be disclosed at any cost as it can have huge repercussions. As each day passes, more vulnerabilities and threats surface and it is important to come up with secure systems and apt security measures to counter these threats and keep the attackers at bay. This study provides a holistic approach to secure and safeguard medical image records by addressing two problems, the first is image tamper detection using medical image deepfake detection to decipher whether the image has been modified or not, and the second is to employ various cryptographic techniques such as hashing, watermarking and digital signatures to protect the images from getting tampered itself.

Author Keywords: Digital Imaging and Communication in Medicine

articleTitle: An Ensemble Performance Comparison of Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Algorithm in Retinal Fundus Images using Different Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a prevalent eye condition among diabetic patients that can lead to irreversible vision loss if not detected and treated early. Early detection and continuous monitoring are crucial for effective management of DR. Traditional diagnostic methods, including visual acuity tests and non-invasive imaging, are often time-consuming and less efficient. Previous approaches, such as Residual Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (RCLAHE), have shown limitations in detecting DR. This research presents an Optimized Back Propagation based Deep Residual Learning Network (Op-BPDRLN) algorithm to enhance the detection of DR. By comparing the performance of different ensemble models on various retinal image datasets, this study aims to develop a more efficient and accurate algorithm for DR diagnosis. The comparison is based on key metrics such as accuracy, error, precision, and recall to determine the most effective classification model.

articleTitle: Poetry Form Identification - A Comparative Analysis of Embedding Models and Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In recent years, automated text classification has advanced significantly, yet poetry classification remains a relatively under-explored domain. By employing Machine Learning and pre-trained language models, the proposed paper aims to automate poetry classification and provide a comparative analysis for utilizing GPT2 (Generative Pre-Trained Transformer), BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), and RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Pre-Training Approach). We have employed tokenization, sequence padding, and fine-tuning on a diverse dataset of poetry forms, including Sonnet, Haiku, Limerick, Acrostic, Ballad, Epigram, Sestina, and Villanelle. The proposed model is trained and evaluated on a dedicated data set using the application of AdamW Optimizer, and strives for robust classification performance. This research study yields promising results, with the Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier achieving the highest accuracy of 93.25 percent using the top 20 percent ranked features. This study contributes to the field of automated poetry analysis by integrating various embedding models and classifiers, presenting notable advancements in the categorization of poetry.

articleTitle: Automated Length-Slice Conveyor for Fabric Handling
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In the printing industry, fabrics are processed according to the design and type of material. Fabric rolls are brought to the printing machine to ensure the desired design is printed with high quality. After printing, the fabric is moved to the drying section to fix the dyes onto the material. Currently, the cloth is collected using a trolley and then manually moved to the packing section, where it is cut to precise lengths. This cutting process is done manually, which can lead to production delays and requires significant manpower. To address these issues, automating the cloth collection and cutting process can improve efficiency. The length of the fabric is measured and cut at regular intervals using a conveyor system and a pneumatic cutter. This method reduces the need for manual labor and speeds up the production process in the printing industry.

articleTitle: Soil Moisture Prediction And Irrigation Control In Agriculture 4.0 With The Cat Swarm Algorithm Optimized Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Agriculture remains one of the most significant industries across the world and the technological advancements in the traditional agricultural industry led to the development of the Agriculture 4.0. The soil moisture aids in determining the amount of water that needs to be fed into the field. Though there are several advantages, the existing methods possess disadvantages such as less accurate prediction, unsustainable data model, and so on. The Cat Swarm algorithm-optimized Deep Convolutional Neural Network (CSA-optimized DCNN) is proposed for soil moisture prediction and irrigation control to tackle the challenges of conventional research and to achieve better prediction accuracy. The DCNN optimized with the CSA adds an advantage as the algorithm optimizes the hyperparameters of the DCNN to enhance the efficacy of the model. The obtained data from the sensor nodes are stored in the server and fetched when need to be processed and fed as the input to the DCNN, which is optimized with CSA optimization to enhance the performance. The research model CSA optimized DCNN is assessed with measures such as Accuracy, Sensitivity, and Specificity and achieves 96.43%, 96.12%, and 98.8% respectively.

articleTitle: Evaluating Machine Learning Algorithms for Landuse Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)

authors.preferredName: M S R Murthy Academic Advisor

abstract: The study analyses various machine learning algorithms for land use and land cover classification and change detection of prakasam district, Andhra Pradesh. The study makes use of multi- temporal Remote Sensing imagery for the years 2017 and 2023 from Landsat - 8 sensor of Prakasam district. Three different machine learning algorithms were used to detect changes in land cover features over time based on classes like vegetation cover, water bodies and human settlements. Later, the work aims to present a complete understanding of change detection methodology used within this research, from preprocessing high-quality Landsat 8 satellite images for better interpretation and identification of spectral values, up to machine learning algorithms in terms land use/land cover classification. The findings reveal the positive transitions in areas of land use/cover between 2017 and 2023, especially cultivated lands as well as water bodies to less extent with a few urban parts. This research will be useful for the remote sensing community as an example of how to detect changes in land cover using ML methods with a high degree of accuracy, overtaking the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Accessibility for the Visually Impaired through Text Voice-Activated Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Empowering the Blind with Text-to-Image Voice Commands: This project combines CNN and object detection methods to enable the blind and visually handicapped. A reliable text-to-image identification system that can precisely describe the content of photos was created by utilizing CNN’s power. Real-time item identification and description in the surrounding environment is made possible by this system’s integration with object detection techniques. With voice command integration and an intuitive interface, people with visual impairments can easily interact with photos and hear in-depth descriptions. Widespread acceptance is ensured by the system’s conformance with current accessibility requirements and extensive testing and improvement that guarantee its correctness and usefulness. By giving visually handicapped people additional abilities to navigate and comprehend the visual world around them, this creative method has the potential to greatly improve their freedom and quality of life. The suggested solution makes use of cutting-edge object detection methods to glean useful information from photos taken with a smartphone or wearable camera. CNN is used to interpret these images and is trained to identify different objects, text, and surrounding features. Text-to-speech (TTS) technology is used to convert the text and objects into descriptive audio feedback after they have been recognized. This gives the user access to real-time auditory descriptions of their environment. Compared to conventional assistive technologies, this novel technique has various advantages for the visually handicapped. It offers a smooth, user-friendly interface that needs little effort on the part of the user, making it easier for those who are visually impaired to obtain information and interact with their environment. Furthermore, the capacity to analyze information in real-time guarantees prompt feedback, improving situational awareness and encouraging increased independence in day-to-day tasks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Real-time Facial Sentiment Recognition Systems through Deep Learning Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) has emerged as a pivotal domain within computer vision, with applications spanning diverse fields such as human-computer interaction, mental health monitoring, and security systems. While significant strides have been made in recent years, accurate recognition of nuanced emotions, particularly fear, remains a challenging task. This research contributes to the advancement of FER technology, paving the way for more sophisticated and empathetic human-computer interactions. By discussing about the reliable and efficient methods for real-time fear detection, this study enables the potential to revolutionize various applications, including mental health monitoring, security surveillance, and autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: Detecting Bias in Legal Language Models through Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The use of advanced data analytics to uncover and mitigate bias in legal language models is important for ensuring the fairness and impartiality of automated legal systems. The research paper focuses on open document repositories for bias detection and analysis in legal language models-the result of training on large text collections dealing with legal material. The broad approach followed integrates quantitative and qualitative techniques from data analytics that make an inquiry into the language patterns and decision-making processes encoded in the model. We create a corpus of legal documents, such as case law, statutes, and legal commentary, publicly available, and the apply a series of NLP techniques (for instance, sentiment analysis and topic modeling) on the text to automatically detect possible biases. Further, we need to train several language models on this corpus using traditional machine learning algorithms and deep learning frameworks to investigate various aspects of how the bias is manifested. These results shows large biases in LMs regarding gender and race, which can be used as supportive argument to extend such biases and propagate historically inequitable treatment and decisions within the law. Using various statistical tests, apart from algorithms that detect bias, we quantify the magnitude and consequences of such biases. This paper demonstrates the importance of transparency and accountability both during the development and deployment of AI technologies within the legal field and offers pathways to more equitable AI applications.

articleTitle: Integrating Cloud Computing and Naive Bayes for Precision Detection and Classification of Sheet and Rill Erosion in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Sustainable agriculture has significant challenges from sheet and rill erosion for effective techniques. A new way to accurately identify and classifier sheet and rill erosion in agricultural landscapes with the combination of cloud computing and Naïve Bayes. To differentiate between these erosion patterns work proposes a technique that uses ground truth data and high-resolution satellite images. The technique gets results by using the Naïve Bayes algorithm, which is famous for being simple and successful in classification problems. More efficient and accurate and advanced methods by conducting comprehensive experiments and validations. This technology takes use of the scalability and accessibility of cloud computing to conduct erosion risk assessments in real-time, providing agricultural stakeholders with valuable information to enhance soil conservation initiatives. It highlights the revolutionary power of new technology to improve agricultural land management methods and address environmental issues. Sustainable agricultural practices mitigate the adverse implications of soil erosion by offering exact detection and classification of erosion events, which lead to better informed decision-making.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Cyberbullying Detection Using Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Cyber Bullying is a problem that plagues the online environment. With the advent of social media after Covid-19, there has been a surge in the number of cases of cyberbullying. Cyberbullying has long-term impacts on the minds of students. There needs to be accurate cyberbullying identification methods. However, there are multiple obstacles when it comes to identifying cyberbullying as the language structure is complex and there are changing terminologies. It is time to leverage a fast-paced system that can understand the complexities of language; the best solution to this is large language models. Sophisticated models like Mistral 7B, Vicuna 7B, and LLaMA 7B can be important in identifying cyberbullying. Training these models using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) can lead to cyberbullying detection with high accuracy. Through extensive testing, this research shows the capabilities of LLMs to detect cyberbullying. This research aims to protect vulnerable groups, foster a safe environment, and automate the recognition of cyberbullying with greater precision.

articleTitle: Exploring the Efficacy of U-Net-CNN Architecture for Automated Detection of Psoriatic Arthritis from Medical Imaging Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Psoriatic arthritis (PsA) is a chronic inflammatory joint disease that often exists with psoriasis, causing substantial morbidity and disability if left untreated. Timely intervention and better patient outcomes depend on the early and precise identification of PsA. This work proposes an innovative method for PsA detection from medical imaging data that uses the U-Net-CNN architecture. Precise localization and characterization of arthritis-associated features are made possible by the U-Net-CNN model, which combines the U-Net architecture for precise segmentation with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for feature extraction and classification. Using a dataset of medical images from Radiopaedia, the effectiveness of the proposed method is evaluated. It shows that, compared with traditional architectures, it achieves a high accuracy of $\mathbf{0. 9 7 4 6}$, precision of 0.9335, recall of 0.9035, Dice coefficient of $\mathbf{0. 8 9 0 5}$, and Jaccard Index of 0.9092.

articleTitle: Exploring Machine Learning in Precision Seeding: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Precision seeding in agriculture requires accurate placement of seeds to optimize crop yield. This paper surveys the application of machine learning (ML) techniques, including Genetic Algorithms, Support Vector Machines (SVM), Back Propagation, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM), and Deep Neural Networks (DNN), in enhancing precision seeding processes. It explores ML algorithms for analyzing soil conditions, weather patterns, and historical data to provide actionable insights for farmers. Additionally, it discusses the integration of machine vision and sensor networks for real-time monitoring of field conditions. Case studies and advancements in precision agriculture are highlighted, and the focus is on practically implementing ML models in the development of seeding equipment and autonomous farming systems. Future research directions and challenges in adopting ML for precision seeding are also discussed. This survey serves as a helpful tool for both researchers and practitioners interested in leveraging ML to transform precision seeding practices and promote sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Fhelo-MTH: Floret Heliotropic Optimized Multilevel Thresholding-based Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The process of segmenting one image into several segments is called image segmentation, which is widely used in several visual understanding applications. Multilevel thresholding-based segmentation enhances the ability to discern subtle changes in the image, making it suitable for detailed image analysis tasks. However, the traditional multilevel segmentation algorithms often pose several challenges including poor segmentation accuracy, stuck in local optimum issues, and minimized convergence speed. Therefore, to tackle the aforementioned challenges, this research proposes a Floret Heliotropic optimized Multilevel Thresholding (FHelO-MTH) algorithm. The integration of the heliotropic movement of sunflowers with the natural pollination process of flowers enhances the FHelO-MTH algorithm to attain optimal threshold values for effective segmentation. Furthermore, the FHelO-MTH algorithm reduces the error rate, improving the proposed algorithm’s overall performance and dependability. When the FHelO-MTH algorithm’s performance is compared to other image segmentation algorithms, the outcomes show a superior Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 45.61 dB.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using Logistic Regression and LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The spread of false information via fake news in recent years has raised serious issues and caused social discontent and division. It is critical to create efficient techniques for quickly and reliably recognizing bogus news. In the context of identifying fake news, this paper compares two popular machine learning techniques: LightGBM and Logistic Regression. Our analysis makes use of a dataset that includes both fake and real news pieces, with 23,481 fraudulent news stories and 21,417 real news stories. Important performance parameters including recall, accuracy, precision, F1-score, and Matthews correlation coefficient are taken into account while evaluating these algorithms. Our goal in doing this research is to clarify how effective these strategies are at solving the urgent problem of the spread of false information.

articleTitle: Heart Sound Analysis and Murmur Classification using Bark Scale Modulation Spectrogram Features
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Detecting heart murmurs is critical for diagnosing cardiovascular conditions, particularly pediatric patients. This study presents a comprehensive approach for processing heart sound recordings and murmur classification using Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks (CRNN). A methodology is proposed for feature extraction based on Bark scale modulation spectrograms to enhance classifier efficiency in pediatric heart sound analysis. Modulation spectrogram features of various heart sound signals are analyzed, and their efficiency across different categories is evaluated. Statistical and spectral features are extracted, and correlations between normal and abnormal heart sound categories are studied. The Bark scale modulation spectrograms are utilized to train and evaluate CRNN performance in classifying heart sounds as normal or abnormal. Performance evaluation shows a 92% accuracy in murmur classification with lower computational complexity. This study highlights the efficacy of modulation spectrogram-based feature extraction and advanced classification techniques in the automated detection and classification of heart murmurs, marking a significant advancement in non-invasive cardiovascular diagnostics for pediatric patients.

articleTitle: Exploring Sub-Nyquist Sampling for Fine Image Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Compared to traditional methods, compressive sensing, a signal processing technique, allows for the effective acquisition and reconstruction of signals. A rate that is less than twice the highest frequency component of a signal is known as subNyquist sampling, allows for the digitization of wideband frequency-domain sparse signals without compromising reconstruction quality when employing compression sensing (CS). According to the CS framework, samples taken at sub- Nyquist sampling rates can be used to reconstruct signals with sparse representations in a known basis. Because of its inherent qualities, the Fourier domain is frequently used in compressive sensing applications. Use of a small number of Fourier transform coefficients in sparse signal recovery applications has led to successful resolutions of large-scale data recovery issues, including image recovery. During the measurement phase, input is systematically measured in blocks to obtain the necessary data, while in the recovery phase, all measurements from a single image are simultaneously utilized to reconstruct the complete image.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sentiment Analysis of Movie Reviews with PySpark
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is pivotal in the film industry as it provides insights into audience opinions, aids in recommending movies, and forecasts box office performance. This research utilizes Apache Spark’s PySpark framework to enhance sentiment analysis in movie reviews. Traditional sentiment analysis techniques often struggle with the large and complex nature of textual data in movie reviews. PySpark’s distributed computing capabilities enable efficient processing and analysis of extensive datasets. We employ logistic regression for classification and validate our model using standard metrics. Our method shows considerable improvements in processing speed and scalability, offering valuable insights into public sentiment and its potential effects on box office outcomes.

articleTitle: Facilitating Seamless Communication through Voice-Enhanced Sign Language and Gesture Recognition with Random Forest Classifier and Graph Convolution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: An innovative system designed to enhance communication for individuals using sign language. Developed in Python, the system leverages a Random Forest classifier to accurately interpret hand movements and gestures, translating them into meaningful linguistic expressions. This approach aims to break down communication barriers by providing outputs in both text and synthesized speech formats, thereby improving accessibility and user interaction. The system’s performance was rigorously evaluated using real-time metrics such as resource usage, voice latency, confidence score, processing time, and accuracy, comparing the Random Forest classifier against Graph Convolution Networks. The inclusion of synthesized speech ensures clear and comprehensible responses, enhancing the overall user experience. Notably, integrating voice voting significantly boosted accuracy to 93.18%, highlighting the efficacy of this method in improving gesture recognition. By combining machine learning techniques with voice-enhanced technology, the system demonstrates a robust solution for real-time sign language interpretation. This research underscores its potential to empower individuals with hearing impairments by facilitating seamless communication through advanced technological integration.

articleTitle: Navigating Guest Sentiments: Comparative Analysis of Decision Tree and VADER for Hotel Review Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: These days, while making hotel reservations, more thought is given to hotel reviews. The views of hotels have grown throughout the past few years. Because of the conflicting assessments, analysis is necessary to identify whether a hotel is positive or negative. The process of analyzing digital text to determine if the emotional tone of the communication is neutral, positive, or negative is known as sentiment analysis. Sentiment analysis is a new field that automates the study of such data by combining Machine Learning (ML) with Natural Language Processing (NLP). Initially, in this research work, dataset is constructed by crawling Tripadvisor data regarding hotel reviews using the hotel review dataset with two distinct algorithms, VADER and Decision Tree. This work has shown that, in comparison to Decision Tree algorithms, VADER is easier to build and determines the sentiment of the dataset. Hence, comparison shows that the Decision Tree method, VADER’s accuracy on the hotel review dataset has slightly improved.

articleTitle: A Novel Automated Approach for Leukemia Diagnosis using Digital Image Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This study introduces a novel automated strategy for diagnosing leukemia through the application of digital image processing techniques. To isolate individual cells in ultra-high resolution blood stain images, the proposed method utilizes state-of-the-art image segmentation. The subsequent phase in the process of accurately identifying leukemic cells is feature extraction, which is designed to emphasize critical cellular characteristics. Then, a machine learning classifier is employed to accurately differentiate between normal and malignant cells. The method’s stated objective is to provide a non-invasive, costeffective, and reliable alternative to current remedies, while also streamlining the diagnostic process. Compared to a reference dataset, this technique’s exceptional sensitivity, specificity, and overall accuracy may be advantageous for clinical leukemia surveillance and early detections. The proposed procedure achieved a precision of $93.2 \%$ and a recall of $96.8 \%$, resulting in a $95.4 \%$ accuracy.

articleTitle: Metc2STM: Metachrosis Coordinate Optimized Convolutional Bidirectional Network for Video Captioning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Video captioning is capturing attention in the computer vision domain. Generating descriptions for video clips is a complex task and the prevailing techniques create challenges like computational issues, generating incorrect captions, the requirement of large databases, and so on. To conquer such limits, this study presents a Metachrosis coordinate optimized Convolutional bidirectional network (MetC2STM) model for accurate caption generation integrating the synergic strength of both the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory and Convolutional neural network. Specifically, the incorporation of Metachrosis coordinate hunt optimization algorithm enhances the tuning ability of the model. An encoder is aided to obtain the characteristic maps from the video frames and an embedded network is deployed for text embedding. In addition, the applied non-local means de-noising enhances the quality of the input frames. Furthermore, the proposed MetC2STM model achieved improvements in BLEU with 46.61, a METEOR of 25.37, and ROUGE scores of 69.26 respectively

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Content Filtering and Blacklisting in OSN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Online Social Networks (OSNs) are becoming increasingly popular due to their extensive communication capabilities, enabling numerous social interactions and content sharing opportunities. However, content posting on these platforms often faces challenges such as unwanted comments and vulgar language. The proposed paper introduces a hybrid approach to enhance content filtering and blacklisting mechanisms in OSNs, along with user image capturing. The rising occurrence of undesirable content, including spam, offensive material, and malicious links, underscores the need for a more robust and adaptive system. The hybrid approach merges rule-based filtering with machine learning techniques to improve the accuracy and efficiency of content moderation. Predefined criteria are used in rule-based filtering and semantic text classification algorithms to identify and categorize unwanted content. Simultaneously, machine learning models, trained on extensive and varied datasets, offer the ability to dynamically adapt to evolving patterns and subtleties in user-generated content. Furthermore, a blacklisting mechanism is included to proactively detect and block content from known malicious sources. The proposed hybrid approach aims to create a safer and more enjoyable online experience for users by reducing the presence of harmful content.

articleTitle: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Convolutional Squeeze Excitation Neural Network based HEVC Video Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Due to the popularity of video streaming on the internet, there is a high utilization of HEVC because of the high compression ratio it delivers in video quality. However, the compression process causes distorting elements that have a negative impact on the quality of the videos, which presents much complication in preserving the content integrity as it was decoded from the videos. To overcome these issues, this manuscript proposes a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Convolutional Squeeze Excitation Neural Network for HEVC Video Quality Enhancement through a two-phase approach: There are two areas namely, (i) Quantization Bit Stream and (ii) post-processing. In the first phase, for example, a Squeeze Excitation Multi-Head Attention-Based Encoder and Decoder radically effects a video frame compression by utilising possibilities of prediction, transformation, quantization, and entropy coding, though it distorts at the same time. The decoder then unpacks the frames thus created to the format that the enhancement module uses as input. The second phase makes use of a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Convolutional Neural Network (HQ2C2N). This approach involves a Feature Extraction Layer that employs quantum circuits to optimize the feature extraction step, a Feature Enhancement Layer that applies classical convolutional networks to eliminate artifacts that have been introduced to the video and a Post-Processing Layer that allows for tuning of end frames to the desired quality standards typical of plyback or further processing. The experiments of the proposed HQ2C2N method are conducted using MATLAB programming environment. The HQ2C2N significantly improves HEVC video quality by effectively reducing compression artifacts, resulting in a higher PSNR of 75 dB and a lower MSE of 0.1%, outperforming previous methods in visual fidelity and performance metrics.

Author Keywords: Squeeze Excitation Multi-Head Attention-Based Encoder and Decoder

articleTitle: Data-Driven with IoT Sensing and Deep Learning Model for Dynamic Skin Cancer Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research introduces an innovative approach to continuously assess the condition of the skin barrier by combining advanced deep learning algorithms with Internet of Things (IoT) sensor technologies. For the system to function, it constantly uses IoT sensors to collect real-time data from various skin metrics, including moisture levels, pH balance, and environmental conditions. A complex analysis, made possible by deep learning, may be built using this vast amount of information. A type of deep learning technique that works well with data, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are at the heart of this system. RNNs capture subtle changes over time in skin health by capitalizing on the temporal dependsequentialencies in skin data. Training RNNs iteratively on historical data covering a wide range of skin types and conditions allows them to detect patterns indicating healthy and damaged skin barriers. The proposed system has several benefits, such as individualized skincare suggestions, real-time information to guide adaptive skincare regimens, and continuous monitoring to identify skin concerns early. The system can discover complex patterns and correlations in the skin data, which results in better skincare solutions.

articleTitle: Feature Integration-based Residual Deep Learning Model for Fake News Detection using Multimodal Data Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The rapid growth of the modern digital world has supported to spread the news rapidly on the social media sectors including Weibo, Facebook, and Twitter. Unconfirmed news is frequently spread in multimedia content form such as video, audio, picture, or text. The propagation of certain false news cheats the public results in protests and generates issues. Fake news propagation has become a significant issue in modern data because of the huge utilization of social media entities. One of the important operations is false news identification, yet the difficulty of some languages makes the identification of fake news complex. The conventional approaches cannot gather many contextual and semantic features from the documents in a specific multilingual text corpus. To overcome such issues, a residual-based deep learning model is introduced for fake news detection using multimodal information. Firstly, multimodal information like text and images are gathered from publicly available data sources. Further, the input text is undergone for pre-processing and it is used for extracting the features. Here, the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) is employed as feature extraction as F1. Similarly, the features from the raw image are achieved by applying the Visual Geometry Group (VGG16), designated as F2. Finally, these two resultant features are concatenated together and subjected to the Residual Recurrent Neural Network (Res-RNN) for detecting fake news. Hence, the proposed system is examined with different metrics and compared with various approaches. Thus, the results declare that the suggested system achieves higher accuracy in avoiding the spreading of fake news over the media.

articleTitle: Seagull-optimized Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Detecting Distributed Denial of Service Attack in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Due to the enormous benefits and applications of cloud computing, there is a lot of interest from researchers on cloud computing. The most significant security risk associated with cloud computing is insider distributed denial of service (DDoS), which affects the entire deactivation of services due to its dispersed architecture and utter dependency on the internet for service supply. Machine learning and Deep learning have appeared as a potent tool in cyber security recently, and numerous attack detection methods have been put out in recent studies. Nevertheless, existing studies on attack detection encounter several challenges, including data imbalance, interpretability issues, inaccurate detection, overfitting, and time complexity issues. Therefore, in order to overcome these difficulties, a deep learning model, Seagull optimized Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique enabled Deep Convolutional Neural Network (SgO-SCNN) is developed in this research to detect DDoS attacks. The optimized SMOTE employed in the model addresses the imbalanced data issue and improves the model’s performance by effectively rebalancing the data. The DCNN classifier can detect the attacks more efficiently and reduces the computation of the model. The seagull optimization tunes the DCNN classifier’s parameters and improves the model’s performance in attack detection with fast convergence, which reduces the model’s time complexity. The experimental outcomes indicate that the developed $\mathrm{SgO}-\mathrm{SCNN}$ model outperforms the existing approaches by attaining enhanced values of accuracy 96.05%, F1-score 94.66%, precision 94.84%, and recall 94.48%.

articleTitle: Smart Tracking and Surveillance Systems for Automated Delivery Robots in Food and E-Commerce Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study provides an innovative approach to creating smart monitoring and surveillance systems for autonomous delivery robots in the food and e-commerce industries. The system aims to increase the effectiveness and security of delivery operations by integrating ultrasonic sensors, radio frequency (RF) modules, cameras, remote controls, and speaker technologies. The robot can recognize obstacles and avoid them due to the use of an ultrasonic sensor. The system includes an RF module to provide seamless connection and remote control. This allows the robot and the central control unit to exchange data in real-time, simplifying remote monitoring, navigational corrections, and operational management. The camera module monitors the robot’s surroundings while recording real-time video visually. Operators or managers are given a remote control so users can monitor and manage the robot’s motions, observe the live video feed, and make smart decisions during the delivery process. The system utilizes a speaker to provide voice-based alerts and notifications. The work advances delivery services in the food and e-commerce industries by enhancing operational efficiency, security, and safety. The performance of the system is analysed in terms of response times, reliability, and accuracy rates and a comparative analysis is also made to show the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Epileptic Seizure Recognition using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The project entitled “Epileptic Seizure Recognition Using Machine Learning Algorithms” is used to identify the epileptic seizure at the early stage. Epileptic seizure is a significant health concern affecting millions worldwide, necessitate precise and timely identification for effective medical intervention and management. The present system for epileptic seizure recognition often relies on traditional methods, including expert analysis of electroencephalogram (EEG) data and manual review. While these methods have proven effective, they are labor-intensive, prone to subjectivity and may not be suitable for real-time monitoring. This gap led to the proposed machine learning-based approach which offer potential seizure recognition, allowing for more timely and accurate intervention. This study propose a novel approach for epileptic seizure recognition by combining dimensionality reduction techniques, namely Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE), with the K-Means clustering algorithm, then integrate this unsupervised clustering approach with four popular machine learning algorithms: Support Vector Machine classifier, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes classifier and Random Forest classifier to enhance the performance of seizure recognition. Each cluster is labeled as either seizure or non-seizure based on the majority class within it. The method involves the development and implementation of these algorithms within the context of epileptic seizure. The primary objective is to explore the feasibility and performance of these classifiers, aiming to enhance the efficiency of seizure recognition system. The work emphasizes the potential of machine learning in automating the identification of epileptic seizures, ultimately contributing to improved patient care and medical diagnosis. The improved accuracy of $95 \%$ is achieved by Random Forest model.

articleTitle: Enhancing Financial Fraud Detection Using LLMs and Advanced Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The complexity and volume of financial fraud poses a significant challenges to the state of the art and evolving detection systems. This makes it necessary for an in depth study and come up with provable techniques with effective approaches. The proposed work focus on algorithmic improvement of the fraud detection technique for financial frauds by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) along with data analytics techniques for inference. Morevover, by leveraging the extensive linguistic understanding and pattern recognition capabilities of LLMs, combined with analytical methods, this research develops a robust framework that improves both the accuracy and speed of fraud detection mechanisms. Our proposed methodology utilizes a designed data collection pipelines, sourcing an array of transactional and communicational datasets from multiple financial institutions. The core of our research involved the development and training of a customized LLM to identify potential fraudulent activities by analyzing textual and numerical data patterns that are typically indicative of fraud. Along with LLMs, state of the art data analytics techniques, such as anomaly detection algorithms and predictive modeling, were utilized to refine the detection process further. The results shows an improvement in detecting fraudulent transactions, with the proposed model achieving a higher precision and recall compared to traditional fraud detection systems. The LLM-based framework efficiently identified complex fraud schemes, which were previously undetected by conventional methods, by effectively analyzing discrepancies and anomalies in large datasets. The proposed approach enhances the accuracy and reduces the response time, thereby enabling financial institutions to safeguard their operations and client assets more effectively.

articleTitle: Scene-Based Event Detection using Grey Wolf Optimization Enabled BiLSTM Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Event detection is a crucial task that enables analyzing the rapid moment of events for rectifying the issues associated with the event that occurred. Despite, several traditional methods have been developed for event detection, the methods lag in identifying the effective localization of key moments and the classification of localized key moments. To address the aforementioned issues and to differentiate the events that contain similar objects or scenes, a novel framework is developed utilizing the Bi-directional Long Short Term Memory with Grey Wolf Optimization (BiLSTM-GWO) for efficient feature extraction and classification. The novel BiLSTM with GWO framework in which the features including the Scale Invariant Feature Transform(SIFT), Hybrid ternary pattern involving the local directional pattern(LDP), local binary pattern (LBP), and local optimal-oriented pattern (LOOP), and Resnet 101 are extracted to assist in learning the relationship between the scenes. For effective event detection, the BiLSTM utilizing the long-term dependency is used and the importance of the developed model relies on the GWO utilizing the encircling and hunting strategies that boost the performance of the classifier. The efficiency of the BiLSTM with GWO approach is evaluated as 91.155%, 91.7%, and 91.505% for sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy respectively with other traditional techniques concerning the USED dataset.

articleTitle: Smart Cradle System for Enhancing Infant Care and Safety using IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The IoT Smart Cradle System revolutionizes infant care by integrating IoT technology into traditional cradles. Through sensors and connected devices, it gathers real-time data on infant movement and sound, transmitting it to users for remote monitoring. The proposed system’s automation features enable remote control of cradle movements and ambient conditions. This innovative solution enhances infant well-being, offers peace of mind to working parents, and ensures a nurturing environment for optimal development. It represents a significant advancement by providing convenient, secure, and customizable care, bridging the gap between technology and tradition for the benefit of both infants and their families.

articleTitle: Automated Paper Waste Segregation System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Manual paper waste segregation in industries often proves inefficient due to the mixture of dry, wet, and metal waste, leading to errors in recycling and increased costs. In order to overcome these drawbacks, an automated paper waste sorting system has been proposed. The system integrates detector technology and mechanical separation mechanisms. Here IR sensors are used to detect waste which is being carried over a conveyorbelt. When waste is detected, relay activates the conveyor belt, which is powered by a DC motor. The conveyor belt helps to move the waste and a rotating handle-like mechanism aids in separating mixed waste. A fan then separates dry waste from the stream, directing it into a collection bin. Metal waste is sorted using a ring magnet, and any remaining wet waste is dried using a blower. Finally, waste is guided towards designated bins based on type, ensuring proper sorting. This technology enhances waste segregation efficiency, reduces operational costs, and promotes environmental stability.

articleTitle: Telehealth Data Security and Privacy Solutions for Sensitive Health Records using Cloud Computing and Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Protecting the confidentiality of patient’s personal health information as it is sent and kept in the cloud is of the utmost importance due to the increasing number of telehealth services. This research provides a new healthcare data security approach using cloud computing and the Isolation Forest method. To identify important challenges and provide a novel technique, a thorough literature study on telehealth security, privacy issues, and cloud-based solutions. It uses the Isolation Forest method for anomaly detection in combination with encryption and access restriction systems to identify intrusion attempts. It uses simulated telehealth data in trials to test the system’s work. Findings show substantial gains in privacy and data security with computational burden. Healthcare practitioners and legislators will find results useful in their pursuit of solutions to the problem of securing patients’ private health information throughout the rise of telemedicine.

articleTitle: Product Quality Enhancement in Social Media using Emotion-Enhanced Bert (EE-BERT) Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Twitter plays an important role in understanding the consumer sentiment about the products. The advanced analytics and Natural Language Processing (NLP) are used to extract actionable insights from this data and useful for a business to improve features and address issues on time for better customer satisfaction and brand loyalty. Most of the current models suffer from a lack of effective ways to handle subtle sentiment analysis because of a lack of contextual understanding and proper feature extraction. Most traditional models cannot combine and optimize features that lead to obtaining sentiments. This leads to overfitting and problems caused by local minima. The proposed Emotion-Enhanced BERT (EE-BERT) model is an extension of the standard BERT to learn contextual embeddings in user sentiment. In this work, data preprocessing includes text cleaning, tokenization, dealing with emojis and emoticons, and lemmatization with the best quality data. The proposed work is basically a dual-stream architecture extended with butterfly optimizer. First, the advanced tokenization and semantic understanding techniques is used for extracting textual features. Second, the emotion-enhanced features extracted through emotion-hash vectorization to enhance the model’s contextual awareness in social media data. This provides a unified framework that combines the feature extraction methods to enhance the accuracy in sentiment analysis. It demonstrated with an impressive accuracy of ${9 8. 2 \%}$ on sentiment in posts and comments with 0.15 losses. The proposed work is free from overfitting and local minima in product quality enhancement.

articleTitle: A Comparative Technique with Credit card based Fraud detection with Machine Learning and Quantum Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Quantum computing greatly benefit a wide range of fields, including the detection of credit card fraud, through its twin characteristics of improved computational power and efficiency. Quantum algorithms are used to enhance data analysis, pattern recognition and optimization properly with increased speed and efficiency.
